Hold on... Phew, feeling better.
You scum, what are you doing?!
You son of a bitch!
Now I'm getting mad!
Looks like I'll have a scar.
Damn it, why hit me in the head?
Now I'm going to tear your head off!
My arm!
Damn! My arm got hit!
Damn it, right in the elbow!
This bastard broke my arm.
My arm's wounded... Damn!
Damn, right in the arm!
I need a bandage, fast!
This wound will cost you your life!
I can take you down with one arm!
Even without an arm, I'll handle someone like you.
One arm is enough to snap your neck.
You break my arm, I break your neck.
I've still got enough strength to knock some sense into you.
Damn, that hurts!
This will make attacking harder.
My skull is tougher than I thought.
Hope I don't need an amputation.
Trying to disarm me, huh?
You'll pay for this injury!
To save your ass, you'll need to take more than just my arm.
It's fine, it'll pass...
This wound won't stop me.
It hurt, but just a little.
Once I catch my breath, I'll quarter you!
A little to the right, yeah, that's better.
Stop with the tickling already.
So you hit me in the chest. Big deal.
I need a stim, now!
More unexpected stim expenses.
Careful, that's my bad liver!
Let me stop the bleeding, then we'll continue.
Hard... to... breathe...
You bastard, you broke my rib!
Broken rib... Time to end you.
An old wound opened up. This is getting out of hand.
Chest wound... I'll survive...
Damn! I think a rib is broken...
Why is there so much blood in my chest?
Is my spine cracked?
Next time, I'll wear better armor.
This gear doesn't even protect my chest.
Now I'll break the ribs in YOUR body.
Right in the chest...
Damn... got the wind knocked out of me...
I'll replace my damaged organs with yours.
Another scar for the chest.
Phew!
Blood's still flowing from the wound...
My ribs!
What, trying to break my ribs?
Damn it, my knee!
Hit me right in the leg...
For that, I'll break both your legs!
I'll kick your ass even without a leg.
Damn, my leg is bleeding.
Urgent! Need a tourniquet!
You won't escape me anyway!
Damn it! My leg!
You just got lucky hitting my leg.
Next time, you won't be so lucky!
So much for my best boots.
This dirty trick won't let you get away.
Damn, my leg! Come closer, coward, come closer!
You'll pay for this!
Just let me get to you...
Come closer...
This bastard broke my leg!
I'll break both your legs for that!
Don't you dare run, you scum!
This wound won't go unnoticed.
Ah! My eyes!
My face! Now I'll have a scar.
My eye! You'll pay for this!
I can't see anything!
Damn you, I can't see!
You bastard...
You'll pay for my eyes, you bastard!
Hey, I can't see anything.
Trying to blind me? Dirty trick!
Just wait, I'll get to you...
Damn bastard!
Hey, you!
Damn it, you won't get away with this!
Breakfast's coming up.
DA-AMN!
Mmm, what pain...
Damn, that hurts!
Urp!
I'll feel this in the morning.
Should've seen this coming...
This job isn't worth it.
You won't get away with this!
I'll deal with you later.
Let the boss choke on his money.
Gotta get out of here!
I'm not dying for my boss!
Let the boss handle it, I'm out.
I've had enough!
I'll be right back...
You'll cost me my job!
I'll dance on your grave.
I don't like this...
Well, crap!
You want my boss, not me.
Better hide out in a dark cellar.
Time to find a new job.
Take what you want and leave.

Keep your money, my life's more valuable!
Love my job.
The boss will reward me well for this.

Just a job, nothing personal.

I'll have to throw you out of here.
I'll deal with you now!
No one will remember you behind bars.
This is what happens to idiots like you!
This will teach you to behave!
You asked for it!
We have a problem. I'll handle it...
Time to end this.
Your death sentence is now!
Someone has to punish you.
Any last words?
Time to earn my pay.
There's always some idiot like you ruining my shift.
Hands up!
Take a nap here.
Time for you to go.

Hey, you!

I see the enemy!
Hope the Paladins see this.
Command will appreciate my training.
Hold it!
Another war begins.
I'll shove my boot so far up your ass it'll come out your mouth.
I like this. Maybe I should be a Paladin.
Reinforcements are coming. You can't escape.
I'll beat you till you're a freak.
I'll kick your ass so hard you'll wear it as a hat.
Perfect for prison labor.
I'm gonna kick your ass!
Here comes the big lead enema.
I'll pretend you're a barrel. Easier to hit.
I'll knock your teeth out and use them for dice.
I'll feed you lead homemade style.
You can't stand against a Brotherhood Knight!
Contact!
My trainer should see me!
Step forward!
How do you like that?!
Long live the Brotherhood!
For the Brotherhood of Steel!
Not enough?
Bend over for a second.
Here's another hit...
First rib, second rib...
Catch!
Boom!!!
Haven't enjoyed a fight like this in ages.
Oops!
Chess game?
Hurts, doesn't it?
I'll destroy you!
Shut up and die!
No defense against a crowbar.
That hit could've killed you.
This is the dullest fight ever.
Ever tried aiming? It helps.
Can't aim at all, can you?
Don't make me angry.
Did they always beat you in training?
The Brotherhood teaches better than this.
My training paid off.
Getting tired, huh?
Don't bother. I'm not in the mood.
This is easy.
Ha!
Some trick!
What was that?
What a pity.
Stop this. Now.
That's Brotherhood training.
Ha, clumsy biped!
Hitting me meant a lot to you, huh?
Perfect pitch.
Ugh, just don't lose consciousness.
The main thing is not to lose consciousness.
Oh, my head.
This is very bad.
Am I seeing... stars?
My head is spinning...
I might lose consciousness.
I'll hit you on the head too.
You almost managed to knock me out.
Holy shit, my skull held up.
I can still handle a weapon.
No more baseball for me.
With this injury, it'll be hard to survive in the wasteland.
My arm!
Look how red it is.
Great, now my arm won't bend.
I won't be able to shoot back like this.
I hope my arm heals soon.
Not the first time.
I'll find ways to beat you even without arms.
At least I'll die with honor.
Where's that damn stimpak?
My maneuver failed.
It'll leave a scar.
We're under attack!
Training was worse.
I should have been more careful.
That hurt.
It'll hurt you more.
The Brotherhood will avenge me!
I've been shot in the leg!
My knee!
Great, now I'll be limping.
Hey, coward, come closer.
Only a coward aims for the legs.
Not a bad tactic for a savage.
That won't help you.
Looks like escaping won't be possible.
I'll have to walk with a cane for a while.
Damn it! My leg!
My eye!
Damn!
Son of a bitch!
Bastard!
This could have been predicted.
Only weaklings aim for the eyes.
Damn, what bad timing.
Look what you've done, bastard.
You'll pay for this in blood.
Dark as night.
What a beast.
I need to sit down for a bit.
Hard to breathe...
Now I definitely won't leave you alive.
Ugh, I won't let this slide.
Come here, you beast!
Old trick.
Just let me catch my breath, and...
Wait a bit...
I feel nauseous.
Retreat!
Sons of bitches...
It's okay, I have a backup plan...
I'm not much use in combat.
We'll meet again on a narrow path.
You're a persistent type...
I'll remember you, we'll meet again.
No negotiating with types like you.
Just savages.
I'm a master of scouting, not fighting.
Alright, this isn't my part.
Damn, if only the paladins were here...
I need to find a place to hide...
Maybe I can bribe you, huh?
Let's wait a little longer.
I surrender!
Should have stayed in California...
Don't kill me! I know a place with heaps of caps!
hint_cs: Měna caps → zatky, ne víčka.

en: Only one of us will survive.
You can't hide from me!
I'll find you in any hole in the Wasteland!
The intel was accurate!
Enemy spotted!
The Brotherhood of Steel can't be stopped!
I'll do it quickly and quietly.
Shouldn't have started what you can't finish.
I'm an unmatched scout.
Let's see what these natives can do.
Time to send your ass to the grave.
You have no idea who you're messing with.
I'll stop you even with bare hands.
Think about yourself and your kids.
Now I'll show you some magic, savage.
Every enemy has weak points.
Someone, cover me!
I hope you have stimpaks, savage...
Stay alert, guys!
Target acquired!
Hello.
Peekaboo.
I'm here.
Want to play hide and seek?
Take a little nap.
There, don't move.
Shut your mouth before others hear.
Come closer.
Submit or die.
Don't relax.
I have something for you.
Oh, someone's about to get hurt!
I'll bury you alive in the sand!
Take your last breath!
No one gets through.
Pathetic sight.
That's what training means.
Capture!
Kiai!
Eighteen strikes technique!
Hey, your shoelace is untied.
You fight like a savage.
What else could be expected from a savage?
Afraid of the fight? Or the consequences?
Camouflage didn't fail.
It's not for nothing I wear camouflage.
You should train more.
Just wasting air.
Don't waste time.
This is simple.
Your hands are clumsy.
I need to take advantage of this moment.
You're far from my training level.
You're no fighter. That's for sure.
Is that all?
You must be seeing double.
Alright, I'll give you one more chance.
You'd miss even a barn door.
You hit like a toothless granny.
Right, just pretend you're fighting.
Looks like I'm losing my balance.
My head... spinning like a centrifuge.
Hey, I need to maintain focus!
Not the head, please!
Spare my head!
I didn't cultivate my brain for this.
Hope this doesn't mar my eloquence.
Blasted headache!
Aah, my face!
This brain is worth a hundred of you.
I can still pull the trigger, you know.
No more baseball games for me.
This injury will delay my reports.
Oh no, my arm!
My delicate bones! They're shattered!
Oh dear, my arm won't bend!
I can't return fire like this.
Need a stimpak quickly, or my arm will be useless.
Not the first time this has happened.
If my hands fail, I'll rely on technology.
I'll need a blood transfusion.
I shall not die in disgrace.
Losing too much blood here.
You're hitting a luminary of science!
Savage beast, I'm a scholar!
Have a death wish, do you?
What are you trying to achieve here?
Could be worse, I suppose.
That smarts!
The Brotherhood will avenge me brutally!
My leg!
My knee!
Wonderful, now I'll be limping.
Will you leave now, perhaps?
Only a coward aims for the legs.
Not a bad tactic for a savage.
See what you've done now?
Escape seems improbable now.
I'll need a cane for a while.
Damnation! My leg!
My eye!
Confound it!
Not the eyes!
Is this even allowed?
Should have seen this coming.
Only cowards aim for the eyes.
Damn, poor timing.
Look at what you've done, you moron.
Trying to blind me, you imbecile?
An eye wound!
You fiend.
Such a low blow.
Breathing is becoming labored...
Quiet now!
Not the groin!
Ugh, this won't go unanswered.
Ha, you missed! Oh, wait...
Oh no, a stimpak won't fix this.
This. Hurts. Immensely.
I'm going to be sick.
I surrender!
This was a terrible idea.
The theory didn't account for this.
Plans went awry. What happened?
Need stimpaks urgently.
The Brotherhood will be mortified.
Stay calm!
I'm of no use in this state.
This is a job for the paladins.
Diplomacy won't work here.
Regrettably, I must take my leave.
This engagement has gone on too long.
Where are those paladins?
I believe you've learned your lesson, and now I'm leaving!
I no longer wish to be part of this.
Let the paladins handle this.
Brains won't suffice here, only brute force.
No use talking to you.
Shoo! Leave!
Leave me alone!
I have a plan.
Don't judge me too harshly.
Another war commences.
Shall we begin?
Please vacate the premises.
I'll kill you with this coffee mug.
When we're done, a stimpak won't save you.
Even scribes must take up arms now.
Where are the paladins looking?
Hey, we have an intruder!
I won't pay for your funeral.
Harsh measures it is, then.
Stop this chaos.
Alright, my patience is spent.
I wanted to avoid this.
Now you'll have to die.
I usually refrain from violence, but in your case, I'll make an exception.
Pity I have to do this.
I need norepinephrine.
Magnificent! Simply magnificent!
Let's explore your inner workings.
Your ribs have a rather low tone, you know.
Sometimes, even I feel like fighting.
Is your skull too tight?
For the sake of science!
Our taxpayers should witness this.
Allow me to introduce myself.
Defend yourself!
Take that!
Die, vermin!
Merely reflexes.
Take that, you loser.
... And one more thing!
I'm strictly following protocol.
That was a postscript.
Think I can't fight?
I'll teach you some manners, savage.
Your era is over, savage.
Stand still!
Now I see your weak point.
It's simpler than it looks.
No wonder the local population is so small.
A prime example of imbalance.
Behold, spacetime distortion in action.
Seems the contact attempt failed.
The natives are too impulsive.
Try practicing more.
Well, well, well...
An intriguing move.
Almost like a chess game.
Don't look at me so pitifully.
Stop dreaming.
What? I was pondering...
You can't surpass your own limits.
Another imbalance, right?
What, a miscalculation?
Precisely as expected.
Aggressive tribe of savages. Noted.
Ha!
Hey, what if I hit you on the head?
Is that a piece of my brain?
A century of life flashing before your eyes in seconds.
My beautiful face!
My brains are frying!
Hey, that was my last tooth!
I already had two holes in my skull.
Oh no, I think that was my nose.
Almost like iron mask therapy.
If I had brains, I'd have a concussion.
Hey, where did my fingers go?
Why am I without a shield like Captain America?
Hey, that's the fifteenth fracture in my arm!
Phew, good thing my nerves have long atrophied.
Ow, ow, my arm!
This arm has been hurting since the old war.
This arm was too long anyway.
I still have more fingers than I should.
This finger will grow back again. Seriously.
Well, there goes another finger.
My fragile little bones!
All my ribs have been broken for ages.
This liver hasn't worked in years.
Ha-ha-ha, it tickles! ...Oh...
Is that a hit? Now super mutants, they tortured me, that was something...
You have no idea what experiments I've been through.
Just smooth out those edges a bit, doc.
That's gonna be another festering bump.
I'll stitch it up as usual.
Hey, I've still got some living flesh in me!
For that, I'll eat you alive.
That old wound opened up again.
I need a doctor!
My precious bodily fluid!
That flesh was getting in the way anyway.
Great, now my good suit is bloodstained.
Is this my blood or engine oil?
I didn't know my blood was that color.
I wish I were that creature from the old movie.
Hey, I've only got one lung as it is.
Don't mess up my only kidney.
Ah, now I can't straighten my back.
Bullies fight just like they did before the War.
This isn't... Oh no, that hurts.
Mexican meat is served.
This dish needs to cool down.
That intestine needed cutting ages ago.
You're right. Why do I need lungs anyway?
Oh, I thought that kidney was dead long ago.
One more scar to add to the collection.
Something happened to my leg, I think.
I'm going to miss that leg.
I'll be limping like a comic book pirate.
Oh no! Where will I find suede shoes like that again!
Looks like I need a crutch for the next month.
Ow, ow, my leg!
Think I can't crawl on my hands?
This is how hotdogs are born.
The bigger they are, the harder they fall...
It'll heal like a dog's wound.
It wasn't seeing much anyway.
No worries, I've still got one left.
Maybe I can just pop it back in?
Don't tell me my eye rolled somewhere.
Oh, I thought I'd never cry again.
Hey, that's my eye, give it back!
Hey, you! Apologize to all the ghouls of Arizona!
Where's my eye, huh? Where is it?
Who turned off the lights?
They told me eyesight fades with age.
You know, I haven't needed this in a while.
Heh-heh, it's almost not a problem for ghouls.
What's that nasty smell? Oh, it's my colon...
Phew! Don't come over here, I let out some toxic gas.
Hands off! I'm not blossoming for you...
Spank me, mommy, for being so naughty.
That's how my grandma used to do it on the coffee table...
Holy shit, finally my bladder opened up!
Not like I could have kids anyway.
Anyone want a soft-boiled egg?
Let's see how you look after a hundred years of ghoulification.
120 years of life, all for nothing.
Take care of my pet mole rat.
I'm not going back to the lab!
I'm a sentient being, you know!
Do you have to hit what you don't understand?
Am I so scary that I get chased everywhere?
Same here as everywhere else.
See you later, smoothskin!
I'm not planning on dying a second time.
My old bones can't take much more of this.
What a world, no peace for the elderly...
Not the right age for fooling around like this.
I need to get out of here.
I'll send you the bill in the mail.
Even during the War, it was better than this.
Any lunatics in your family?
I'll be back at midnight sharp.
Looks like the joke turned into a tragedy.
You take everything too seriously.
My bones aren't up to running around.
What a... smooth face you have.
Your skin... so tender.
Just like in the old days.
Enough persecution of ghouls!
Ghouls have endured this treatment for too long!
Hope your head stays in one piece...
Mmm, I love smoothskins.
Guess who's coming to dinner.
Tilly-tilly-tilly-bom!
~ But Johnny won't be coming home! ~
Your smooth skin makes me hungry.
After you die, you'll be uglier than me.
I'll lock you up in a dungeon!
Watch "Brain Hunters" right now...
I still remember how to fight!
I'll gut you like an old pinata!
Don't be shy with the rough words.
Imagine you're a little girl.
Smoothskins are such wimps.
I'll peel off your warm skin.
I'll peel your skin like an orange.
I could use some fresh organs.
Goal!
Look at you, turning pale.
More brains...
Let me at least taste it!
This meat should be tender and juicy.
Oh yes, my taste buds are about to go to heaven.
Before the War, I wouldn't have been allowed to do this.
Dry your paddles.
Here's a Christmas present for you.
Ah, the good old days.
Today, the police won't help you.
This is how all civilizations end.
Bam!
Boo! Scared?
Don't hesitate to panic.
You might want to change your underwear.
Time for bed and a potty break!
Keep going like that.
Want some fried nails?
Something's not working out?
There hasn't been a loser like this since the Old World.
Starting to feel tired?
Lady Luck is not on your side today.
Nice try, but I'm already here!
I'm ridiculously lucky!
It's like rolling five dice and getting ones on all of them.
You smoothskins are all the same.
That's how NOT to play baseball.
Stop beating around the bush.
You can't kill what you can't hit.
*cough-cough*
Maybe, maybe...
That's more fear than excitement.
And they laugh at ghouls...
Want to try again?
Well, you're a loser.
Today is not your day.
Brains...
I'll tear it up!
Eat!
Grab it!
Lunch!
Die!
Rip!
Brains!
Fresh-atina...

Squeak-squeak!
Squeak-squeak-squeak!

Snort!
Gr-r!
My head is about to burst like an overripe fruit.
Oof, that hurt!
Hey, that hurts, you know!
Hey, I'm not hitting you on the head!
My head!
My face is covered in blood...
I'm about to pass out.
Ow, ow, ow!
Stop, don't hit me in the face!
I hear ringing in my ears.
Ah, my arm!
My arm... Ah, it hurts so much!
My arm hurts. Really bad.
That crunch doesn't sound good.
I use this arm to gather corn!
This is my working arm, you!
How will I provide for my family now?
What are you doing, you brute?
No, don't break my arm!
No, don't break my fingers!
Whose blood is this? Mine?
Oh God, is that my blood?
So much blood...
What are you doing?!
Ugh!
Oh, that hurts so much!
I'm passing out.
Who will take care of my family now?
I'm dying!
Lord, why did you have to do this?
Ow! My leg...
Ah! My leg!
Ahh! My knee hurts!
Ah! My knee!
My leg is going numb. Oh God, nooo!
Because of you, I'll be limping.
My leg will hurt for a long time.
Oh, my leg.
Ungh... my leg... is done for...
I hope they tear off your legs like that.
My eyes!
I'll have to wear a bandage like my grandfather.
I won't see the crops sprout anymore.
Planting corn blind is going to be a problem.
A bit more and my head will burst like an overripe mutfruit.
This is so unfair...
God, what cruelty.
An eye for an eye.
Don't touch my eyes!
Not the eyes! I beg you!
Only the worst scum aim for the stomach.
I'll curse your lineage for five generations!
And for this, revenge will be especially brutal.
Car-ramba!
Hey, stop it, you animal!
You bastards, how can you do this?
Kill that beast!
For that...
Oh, I need a toilet urgently.
I will get my revenge for this.
Leave us alone!
We have nothing to steal!
We don't want any trouble!
We are peaceful people, don't touch us!
Let me see the crops one last time!
Don't kill me!
Saludos, amigos!
These are tough guys!
With each season, the raiders get bolder!
Take whatever you want, just don't touch my family!
Bury me on my land.
Don't come near! I, uh, have wasteland disease.
Why don't you just take the food and get out of here?
I don't want any dealings with you.
We have nothing more to talk about.
This time, the strangers defeated us.
Look at the trouble these strangers bring us.
I'll hide in those bushes until the strangers leave...
We don't know how to fight!
What are you doing? We need to hide in the cellars right away!
Strangers!
You shouldn't have come here.
Let's see what you're made of.
The Villa doesn't need you.
We don't need people like you here!
You won't show up here again.
Get out of the Villa, strangers! And don't come back!
We know how to take care of ourselves.
No one will take this place...
Brothers, rise up to defend the Villa!
This is what we do to unwelcome guests.
Enough of these freeloaders!
We need to drive them out of the village.
I won't let them destroy what we've built.
We are peaceful people... Mostly.
And how do you like this?!
Just try touching my supplies!
One step on my land and you're dead!
I won't just get to you, I'll kill you! Mexican style!
Get back to the wasteland, stranger!
You desert rat!
Goodbye, scum!
Dirty raiders!
Damn freeloaders!
We've put up with them for too long!
Get out!
Get out, you damned gringos!
We have our own ways here!
Someone needs to teach you a lesson.
No one will bury you here.
This is my land!
You've overstayed your welcome!
Time to visit your ancestors!
Get off our land!
Surprised, huh?!
It'll get worse from here!
Let's hang them on a tree!
We have our own justice... Bring the rope!
I don't like your kind...
You can't do whatever you want here.
We're not that easy to kill.
We're not as weak as you think.
You're playing with fire.
Don't soil your pants.
Does your crotch feel tight?
I'd have hit the mark three times already.
Go to hell!
Get lost!
I don't give a damn!
Son of a bitch!
Stupid gringo.
Die, enemy!
Green as the corn shoots.
You'll rot in a pile of manure.
Want to be hanged? We can arrange that.
Soon your head will grace a noose.
You're a joke.
Strangers can never be trusted.
The treachery of strangers knows no bounds.
No one invited you here.
I'm crying... bloody tears!
The mist hides my path.
My ancestors are calling me!
I hear... the howl of the Great Jackal.
It'll make a beautiful scar.
Oooooooo!
Evil spirits are in my head.
A Jackal without fangs is no Jackal.
Cough-cough!
It's so dark... Am I in the Heavenly Kennel?
The bone is so white.
Arrrr!
I think I broke a claw.
I can manage without one finger.
Hey, I grew these claws for months!
I'll gouge out your eyes with the remaining fingers.
Leave me a couple of fingers at least.
Damn, another claw broken.
I'll kill you with just one hand.
I'll tear out your throat with my teeth, even without hands.
Arrrrr!
Where did the air go?
Weakness is spreading through my body.
The Great Jackal is calling me.
Don't think you can escape the Jackals.
Great Jackal, the stranger is killing me!
Great Jackal, give me strength!
The ancestors' charm didn't work.
The priestess's dance was supposed to protect me.
Why didn't the priestess avert this wound from me?
Let me catch my breath - and I'll get you.
I'll replenish this blood with yours.
The meat looks so pretty... no, it's MY meat!
I've been gutted like a rad-pig.
Feels like a rib is broken.
I don't feel so good.
Why don't I feel the pain?
My breakfast wants to come out.
These wounds will take a long time to lick.
The smell of blood... my blood.
Are you going to dismember me?
Don't show my remains to the Jackals.
If you kill me, eat me whole.
The hour of my death is near.
Jackals, help me!
Jackals, the stranger is killing me!
I'll remember this fight.
This person fights better than the Jackals.
My trophies can't protect me.
Where's the spirit of the ancestors when you need him?
The bone is so white.
There's no running now.
I'll crawl to you anyway.
I don't feel my lower paws.
I'll eat my own leg when it's all over.
Can't walk. It hurts... so much.
I'll make you walk on hot coals.
*whines*
No worries, I'll wait until you come closer.
The leg burns like it's being roasted.
At least I can still hear you.
At least my nose works fine.
I don't need eyes to smell you.
Darkness, darkness!
His spirits have stolen my sight.
Where are you?
Where am I?
Arrr!
*whines*
I'll smell your scent anyway.
Ooooooo!
*loud whine*
How it hurts.
How it burns...
Ow!
Mmm. For that, I'll kill you slowly.
I'll crawl and kill you anyway.
Even among Jackals, this is considered dirty.
With a scar like this, I can't continue the lineage.
I already have a large litter.
I'll be back. And I'll be your worst nightmare.
Save the pups!
Jackals, save yourselves!
I won't eat people anymore, I promise!
Spare me, spirit of the Wasteland!
The Jackals are fleeing!
The Jackals are running!
The Jackals need to survive!
There's a dark spirit in our lair!
*makes a plaintive howl*
Jackals, run away!
This lair has become dangerous.
Looks like this prey is too much for us.
Spare me! I've always been a loyal Jackal!
Let the priestess deal with this spirit.
Grandfather's bone says to run away.
I smell fear... MY fear!
May the Great Jackal forgive me.
You underestimate us.
My legs are faster than yours.
Forward, Jackals!
Woo-oooo-oooo!
*makes a dog-like howl*
My kids will have a feast tonight!
Fres-sssh meat!
This time, it's a fat prey.
I'll devour you slowly!
When I skin you, I'll call the kids to learn.
My kids will love getting your teeth as gifts.
I want to hear your screams!
cs: I want to hear your screams!

en: I want to see your suffering!
Today, you'll be worm food.
You'll die in terrible pain!
I'll feed my whole family with you.
Sharpening my teeth was not in vain today.
Grrrrrrr!
Jackals! Open your jaws!
Need to sharpen my claws.
I'll find use for some of your organs.
I'll present your head to the alpha female.
Mmm, white meat!
Here's our lunch!
Blood for blood!
Let's see what's inside you.
Let's see what color your blood is.
Look at you bleeding so sweetly.
Death will only make you prettier.
*growls like a jackal*
Jackals, surround him!
I'll jump on him from behind!
Your skull will decorate the priestess's throne.
I'll tear his artery with my claws!
I'll wash my claws in your blood!
Now we'll taste your blood!
I'll make a necklace from your teeth!
I'll skin you alive!
I'll bathe in your blood!
I'll rip out your heart!
I'll boil you alive!
I'll tear your flesh from the bones!
*maniacally laughs*
*gurgles like a jackal laughing*
Hee-hee-hee!
Jackals aren't easy to catch.
We're too cunning for you, human.
Come closer, s-stranger!
Only a cowardly rat would miss like that.
The mushrooms have made me invincible.
Are you getting t-tired, human?
Ha! The Great Jackal protects me!
I am chosen by the Great Jackal!
You can't handle me, human.
Lost your pack, pup?
You'll be easy prey.
Outsiders are weak because they don't eat humans.
This h-human is weak.
A h-human without a pack is useless.
Our pups fight better than you.
You fight like a pup.
A pig rat fights better than you.
I talk... to a Divine Brahmin.
My head!
Why the head?!

en: Skill Points
Use free skill points to increase the level of a skill.  As you get better at a given skill, however, it takes more points to raise that skill.  Mastering a skill can take a lot of time and effort.
ru: Дополнительные очки навыков можно использовать для повышения навыка. Чем лучше вы владеете навыком, тем больше очков понадобится для его повышения.
cs: Volné dovednostní body můžeš použít ke zvýšení úrovně některé ze schopností.  Jak se bude tvá postava postupně zdokonalovat, bude tě i každé nové procento stát více dovednostních bodů.

Tag Skills
Tag skills are skills your character specializes in.  Each tag skill gains +20%, and increases twice as fast.  You must pick three tag skills.
ru: Навыки, на которых специализируется ваш персонаж. Каждый основной навык получает +20% в начале и увеличивается в два раза быстрее. Необходимо выбрать три основных навыка.
cs: Talenty jsou schopnosti, na které se tvá postava specializuje.  U každého talentu získá postava do začátku bonus +20% a zároveň se v něm zdokonaluje dvojnásobně rychle.  Musíš vybrat tři.

en: Optional Traits
Optional traits describe your character in more detail.  All traits will have positive and negative effects.  You may choose up to two traits during creation.
ru: Дополнительные особенности - штрихи к портрету вашего персонажа.  Все особенности имеют положительное или отрицательное влияние. Вы можете выбрать максимум две особенности во время создания персонажа.
cs: Charakterové rysy popisují tvou postavu do větších podrobností.  Každý z nich má pozitivní i negativní efekt. Během tvorby postavy si musíš zvolit dva.

en: Skills
Skills are learned knowledge.  Skills increase by experience, or during the course of the game by special events.  The higher the skill level, the better you are at that skill.
ru: Навыки - приобретенное знание. Навыки увеличиваются с опытом, а также с помощью особых игровых событий. Чем выше уровень навыка, тем лучше вы им владеете.
cs: Dovednosti jsou vytrénované schopnosti. Dovednosti se zlepšují zkušenostmi nebo speciálními událostmi během hry. Čím je dovednost vyšší, tím je tvá postava v daném oboru lepší.

This is a ranged stat that represents your general reputation. The higher the number, the better known and respected you are. If your rep is negative, you are hated by some for your evil actions.

en: You have killed a large number of people. This is generally not a good thing to get known for. People from the wrong side of the track will like you a little more, however.
cs: Zabil jsi spoustu lidí. A to není moc dobrý způsob, jak se proslavit. Lidé z podsvětí si tě ale váží a respektují tě.

en: Your actions have revealed you to be a champion of the people. Your war against evil and villainy is widely known. Honorable people will respect you better.
cs: Tvé činy z tebe udělali šampióna. Tvůj boj se zlem a hanebností je všeobecně známý. Čestní lidé si tě váží a uznávají tě.

en: You thoroughly enjoy Nuka-Cola, the pop of the post-nuclear world.
cs: Umíš si důkladně vychutnat Nuka-Colu, nealko-nápoj postnukleárního světa. Možná až moc důkladně.

en: You are addicted to the drug Buffout. You must take this drug on an ongoing basis or suffer the effects of withdrawal.
You are suffering from Mentat addiction. You must take this particular drug or suffer withdrawal.
You have a drug addiction. If you do not take Psycho on a regular schedule, you will suffer. If you do, others will suffer.
Your body has become addicted to RadAway. While not life threatening, you must take it regularly.
cs: Tvoje tělo potřebuje stálý přísun chemikálie Radaway. Nijak tě to sice neohrožuje na životě, nicméně ji musíš brát pravidelně.

en: You have a problem with alcohol. Actually, you have many problems with your drinking habits.
cs: Máš menší problém s alkoholem. No, vlastně je to spíš větší problém.

en: You have a drug addiction. You must take Jet on a regular basis.
Tragically, you are addicted to the Garnering. You are constantly in search of new expansions.
cs: Bohužel, už je to tak. Jsi závislý na karetní hře "Tragic the Garnering". Cítíš neustálé nutkání shánět nové a nové sady karet.

en: You have killed children, the youth of the wasteland. This is considered to be a really bad thing. You evil, evil person.
cs: Co ti k tomu mám říct? Zabíjíš nevinné a neozbrojené děti. Chceš opravdu slyšet, co si o tobě myslíme?

en: You've killed a lot of people. And you did it with style. Not everyone likes people like you, even in a post-nuclear world.
You are a born hunter. You've butchered so many wild animals that you've lost count.
You kill mutants. Cleansing the modern world from all kinds of mutants has become your calling. Some people admire you, others, you frighten.
You have reached level 12, and very few people (or even none) have died due to your fault. With such an outlook on life, it is a miracle that you yourself are still alive.
You have joined the Brotherhood of Steel. Although your training is not yet complete, this already says a lot about your capabilities.

Your relentless dedication and unwavering service have significantly advanced the mission of the Brotherhood of Steel. In recognition of your exemplary efforts, the Elders bestow upon you the esteemed title of Accomplished Scribe.

Through your unwavering commitment and remarkable contributions, you have greatly furthered the Brotherhood's cause. As a testament to your achievements, the Elders honor you with the distinguished rank of Accomplished Knight.

Your valor and steadfast service have proven invaluable in advancing the Brotherhood's mission. In acknowledgment of your exceptional contributions, the Elders elevate you to the honored rank of Accomplished Paladin.

With your exceptional skills and relentless determination, you have made significant strides in advancing the goals of the Brotherhood. The Elders, in recognition of your outstanding service, confer upon you the respected title of Accomplished Scout.
You betrayed the Brotherhood of Steel after all they did for you. The Brotherhood does not forgive this. Never.
You have officially been accepted into the ranks of the Rangers. Now it is your responsibility to create order in the Wasteland.
The Church of the Holy Fire has accepted you into its narrow circle of initiates. Few have succeeded.
The Highwaymen now consider you one of their own and are ready to come to your aid from now on.
You are now a runaway slave. You will have to constantly hide from your pursuers until you manage to obtain your freedom from your slave owner.
You... have transformed. You've become a new person. This makes you see yourself in a new light. And the entire world around you.
You have rejected progress in favor of maintaining tradition. By doing this, you have inspired the people of the Villa and proven your dedication to the ideals of the community.
You have rejected tradition in favor of progress. You have your reasons, but most of the Villa's residents are unlikely to agree with you on this issue.
You are the heavyweight champion of Phoenix. You have gained fame, respect and love from thousands of fans.
Idolized
Liked
Accepted
Neutral

Vilified
Everyone in this area would like to be you. You're the toast-of-the-town and are held up as a shining example of all that a person can be.
cs: Tady by se ti chtěl každý podobat. Jsi miláčkem města a pro všechny zářným příkladem a ukázkou toho, jak vypadá opravdový hrdina.

en: People wave, and greet you, wherever you go in this area. Everyone has heard talk of you, and they like what they've heard.
cs: Lidé tě vítají a oslavují, kdykoliv jen vejdeš na toto místo. Všichni  o tobě slyšeli a všem se to, co slyšeli, moc líbilo.

en: Although, you're not greeted with open arms, most people in this area will at least nod in acknowledgment when you meet. You fit in as well as most.
cs: Ačkoliv nejsi vítán přímo s otevřenou náručí, většina lidí ti v tomto místě na pozdrav odpoví. Nejsi pro ně ničím zvlášť výjimečným.

en: Though normally suspicious of strangers, the people of this area haven't made up their minds about you yet.
cs: Ačkoliv jsou obvykle vůči cizincům podezřívaví, proti tobě lidé na tomto místě nic nemají. Zatím.

en: You're just another out-of-towner in this area. Probably up to no good.
cs: Pro lidi v tomhle místě jsi jen dalším cizincem. Nutno dodat, že nijak zvlášť vítaným.

en: You've proven to the people in this area that their initial distrust was well founded. People in this area look at you and mutter to one another when you come near. They know you're up to no good.
cs: Lidem na tomto místě jsi dokázal, že jejich počáteční odpor vůči tobě, byl víc než oprávněný. Všichni zmlknou, když se k nim přiblížíš. Už tě znají.

en: Staring and muttering, some cross the street to avoid walking near you, while others, spit and turn away when you come near. Everyone knows that you're one of the worst things that's ever slithered into this area.
cs: Když kráčíš ulicí, všichni zmlknou a s nenávistí a strachem tě pozorují. Každý se ti snaží vyhnout. Všichni ví, že ty jsi ta nejhorší věc, která kdy vkročila na toto místo.

I won't survive without a leg!
Now they'll call me Limpy.
Losing a leg is the last thing I wanted.
I can't walk anymore!
Guess I won't be dancing anymore.
Looks like I won't be running again.
Aaargh, my eyes!
My eyes! What's happening to them?!
My face!
My eyes! I can't see!
Please, not the eyes!
Oh god, I can't see anything!
I'm going blind, no-o-o!
If I go blind, just kill me now.
Oh god, please, not blindness!
Stop hitting my eyes, I'll go blind!
Ow, my stomach!
Ugh!
My... guts... Aargh!
Such pain! I'm dying!
O-oh!
Such pain, such pain...
It's getting... hard to move...
Ow-ow! Where's the nearest toilet?
Hey, don't hit there, I want kids! Just decided!
I need to sit down...
Aaaaaah!
Help! They're killing me! Help!
Help! Maniac on the loose!
Stop, please, stop!
Have mercy!
I don't have anything! Have mercy on me!
Please don't kill me, ple-e-ease!
No, please, don't hit me anymore!
Not me! Don't kill me, please!
I don't know what I did wrong, but I'm so sorry-a-aah!
I can't take any more of this!
One day you'll sleep, and I'll be there.
Run! Run away!
It was fun, but I gotta go!
Please, not this, I need to get out of here.
Oh god, oh god, oh god, no-o-o!
Hope is all I have left.
Run for your life!
Oh god, oh god, oh god...
cs: Ach bože, ach bože, ach bože...

en: Mercy! I beg you!
Uh-oh... it's happening... right?
Oh yeah, I've been waiting for this!
Uh, wait!
Okay, now I'm starting to get mad.
Oh, there's going to be blood. I'll bring the bandages.
Promise not to get mad.
I'm trying, don't interrupt.
I honestly didn't want to do this...
Uh, I don't want to hurt anyone.
Don't make me hurt you.
Just leave, and I won't get hurt.
Oh god, forgive me for my sins.
I guess I have to defend myself.
I always thought I wouldn't go this far!
This will be the last time, okay?
I warn you - I'm scary when I'm angry!
I, uh, I'm not aiming at you, honest.
Now everyone will know my true power!
I'm as fierce as a wild radroach!
Time to remember all grandma's lessons.
There! Now I suggest you run.
I didn't mean to! Honest!
No one will ever laugh at me again!
Yes! Yes! Ye-e-es!
Feel the rage of the nerd!
I never thought I'd do this!
You forced me to!
Holy shit, I did it!
I, uh, am a dangerous criminal. So don't make me mad!
Allow me to hurt you, if you don't mind, of course.
Yeah, who's afraid of who now?!
I didn't want this fight, but...
Someone needs a reality check.
Y-you, b-be careful!
I apologize in advance.
A monster is being born within me!
Hey, this isn't so hard!
Oops, that was an accident.
I'm a scoundrel like no other!
I wouldn't have done this on my own!
No! No! No!
Hey, you could have hit me! Alright, alright, I'm silent...
That wasn't nice at all.
Are you sure you know how to handle this?
Looks like I got really lucky.
What? I'm still alive? I'm alive!
You don't really want to kill me? Uh, right?
Stop it! I have nothing to do with this!
Good thing I'm so agile.
That was too close.
I knew from the start that you didn't want to kill me.
I wasn't hit? I can't believe it.
Ha! I'm still alive!
Holy shit, that would have hurt if it hit.
I'm dying! Dying... Oh, no, false alarm.
I'm sneakier than I look! Remember that.
Hey! You could have hurt me!
Missed? I can't believe my eyes!
What a relief - I'm still alive!
Just a little bit more...
Everything's spinning like a merry-go-round!
Ouch, that hurt more than a breakup!
One star... two stars... hope I don't hit five!
My beautiful face! Nooo!
I think I'm going to pass out... or maybe take a nap...
Right on the noggin! Bullseye!
Oh, my poor, aching head!
Feels like my skull is splitting... or just really disagreeing with me!
Well, there goes another tooth! The Tooth Fairy's gonna be rich!
What? How long was I out? Did I miss lunch?
Ah! That's not what I signed up for!
My hand! My precious hand!
Argh, my hand! Did someone catch that on camera?
Man, that stings worse than a breakup text!
My arm hurts. Like, seriously bad.
My arm hurts. I need a doctor, stat!
My whole arm looks like a pretzel!
Broken here... and here... oh, just great.
You broke my arm! Who's paying for this?
Ahh, they broke my arm! You're on my naughty list!
I can't feel my hand! Did it clock out early?
Won't someone fix my hand? Pretty please with sugar on top!
My finger got blown off! Stop the chaos, seriously!
Stop! How am I supposed to feed my family without a hand?
Please leave at least a couple of fingers! I need those!
My fingers are going numb... is this how Frosty felt?
Hey, check out what you did to your hand!
Too much blood! Someone get me a bandage, ASAP!
A bit more, and I'd be waving goodbye to my hand!
This hurts so bad... I thought pain had limits!
Why are you doing this to me? Do I owe you money or something?
What's that poking out of my chest? That's not normal, right?
Ribs! That really, really hurt!
I can't breathe right... is this what fish feel like?
This looks like trouble with a capital T.
It doesn't hurt much, but I'm losing enough blood to fill a kiddie pool!
You're footing the medical bill for this, buddy!
Doctors, to the rescue!
This wound is giving me dangerous vibes!
Why won't my back straighten? Did I turn into a question mark?
I think something broke inside me... hope it's not my will to live!
*coughs blood* This can't be good.
Whose blood is this? Hope it's not mine!
I should probably lie down until this bleeding stops.
Breathing is hard... am I under water or something?
I won't do anything crazy, just don't kill me!
That's a lot of blood... is there a vampire convention nearby?
Getting warm... and sleepy... time for a nap?
*heavy breath* That was my dramatic sigh.
Can't...breathe... gotta catch my breath!
I think I'm... dying... or just really tired.
Help me! Somebody, save me!
Don't kill me, I have a family! And I'm an artist!
Owww, my chest feels like it's on fire!
hint_cs: Metafora bolesti/tepla — ne bojový stav „v plamenech“.

en: Wait... gotta catch my breath...
Hold on, I need to count my ribs.
At least let me have one last smoke before I kick the bucket.
Ugh, I really need to quit smoking after this.
My lungs took a coffee break.
One less rib, hope it wasn't important!
My leg! I need that for walking!
Ouch, my knee is screaming louder than my ex!
I think it's gone... Aah! The pain!
Blood is leaking from my boot... it's not a fashion statement!
I can't feel my foot! Did it go on vacation?
I think I got shot in the leg... just my luck!
My leg is MIA!
Call a doctor! I'm stuck like a statue!
Stop it before I turn into a complete cripple!
You better pay for my leg's treatment, pal!
Hey, cut it out!
I can't walk anymore! Thanks for that!
It hurts to move. I'm not cut out for this!
I was shot in the leg. Can someone write me a sick note?
My knee is wrecked. Who's paying for this?
This injury is totally on your conscience!
Great, I'll be rocking crutches for the next few months.
I don't want to be a cripple!
Who needs a one-legged person now?
No leg, no life, and it's all YOUR fault!
My eyes! My precious eyes!
Oh no, my eye!
Be careful, or I'll go blind!
I can't see anything! Did someone turn off the lights?
Not the face! It's my best feature!
If I go blind, it's on you!
I'm going blind! Nooo!
Hey, you hurt my eye!
It's getting dark in here... is there a blackout?
I'll give anything to not go blind!
Shame on you!
What kind of monster are you?
Is this your idea of fun? Really?
Oh, the pain, the pain!
Uh-oh! That can't be good.
Damn, that stings!
Only a real jerk would do this!
Where the heck are you aiming?!
There go my plans for kids.
With this injury, say goodbye to all my plans.
Help! I'm being murdered!
Somebody, help me!
I've had enough of this nonsense!
Please, no more!
Please, just stop!
Just leave us alone, okay?
I don't want to die! I've got stuff to do!
You're not going to kill me, right?
Please, don't hit me again!
Sorry, but I've got to run.
Damn, I thought you'd be easier to deal with.
Can't you pick on someone else?
I'm not coming back here, ever.
Please, stop hurting me!
It's just not worth it, seriously.
Holy shit, time for a smoke break.
Okay, I was never here.
Uh, see you around... or not!
I gotta go! Like, right now!
Hang on, I'll be back in a minute... or not.
I don't want the neighbors to see me dealing with you.
Stay still, and I'll make this quick.
This won't take long, promise.
Stop that jerk!
I don't think you're going to like this.
cs: Mylsím, že se ti nebude líbit! Ale mě jo!

en: Now it's my turn to have some fun.
Time for a little dance, shall we?
I really don't want to do this, but you leave me no choice.
You're really getting on my nerves.
Somebody needs to teach you some manners.
I'm getting pretty tired of this.
It's a shame it had to come to this...
Why does it always come to this?
Just go away, and no one gets hurt.
Because of parasites like you, honest folks can't catch a break.
I don't want to kill anyone else. Please don't make me.
I really hope nobody's going to miss you.
Someone's going to pay for all this.
Nobody wants you here.
I hope this doesn't backfire on me.
Take that! How do you like them apples?
Take that!
How does that feel? Not good, right?
Yeah, take that!
How do you like that?
Oh yeah, right there!
Uh-oh, looks like someone's bleeding!
Yeah, step right up for the next hit!
How do you like that? Not fun, huh?
Ha, enjoy that? Didn't think so!
Time for a little nap!
Take that! And that! And that!
Take that, you had it coming!
Now you've got me really ticked off!
Don't make me do this again.
Hope that hurts!
This'll teach you some manners.
You won't be hurting anyone else!
This is just the beginning of your lesson!
It's only going to get worse from here!
Hey, you almost hit me!
Damn raiders!
This is just chaos!
Stop, someone's going to get hurt!
You could kill someone with that!
Why are you doing this? Looking for trouble?
If you're looking for trouble, find it somewhere else.
Just a bit more...
Looks like you were more bark than bite.
Don't you dare try that again.
You missed! Let's call it quits.
You're not going to hit me!
You're a terrible fighter.
Go back to your cave, savage.
Better stay home and keep your head down.
Am I bleeding? No? Phew!
Phew, that was close...
Good thing I'm quick on my feet!
Okay, okay, I'll dance! Just leave me alone!
Hey, watch it!
You scumbag, you broke my nose!
I'm gonna tear your head off for that!
Son of a... Why'd you have to go for the head?!
Guess I'm gonna have a scar to brag about now.
That hurt like a son of a gun!
Hey! Go break skulls somewhere else!
You dirty...
What? Is it night already?
Who turned off the lights?
Hey, where'd everyone go?
My arm!
Arrgh, my damn arm!
You bastards hit me right in the elbow!
That stung like a hornet!
Damn, that smarts!
My arm's a mess because of you!
You're gonna pay for this injury!
My arm's going numb... You bastards!
Hurts like hell...
You're paying for this pain, you hear me?!
Those bastards busted my arm.
Somebody, help me wrap this arm up!
Argh, my arm's burning like a forge!
I only need one arm to thrash you.
I've got enough strength left to knock some sense into you.
Damn, I can't swing like I used to.
One arm's all I need to take you down.
Hard to punch your face with a bum arm!
Hope I don't have to chop it off...
This finger's gonna cost you your life!
My ribs!
You're gonna regret that!
I ain't liking this one bit.
Hey, take it easy!
What, you wanna break my ribs now?
Yeah, that's how ribs get busted.
Ugh! That's painful!
Oof! You cracked my rib, you jerk!
Now you've really pissed me off.
Damn it, right in the lung!
Hey, watch it with my spleen!
Hey, you're ruining my outfit here.
Pretty sure that was my lung.
There was a lot of blood... once.
Damn, that hurts!
Nobody hits me like that!
Let me catch my breath - then you're dead meat...
You have no idea who you're messing with.
You've managed to bust something inside me.
Breathing's tough... but you're gonna feel worse.
A scar across the chest! Now that's just too much...
Alright, now I'm really mad.
Hold me back, I'm about to lose it!
Hit that spot again and I'll string you up myself.
Better get out while you still can.
My chest's burning up.
Pain's spreading through my chest.
Ugh! Blood's still pouring from the wound.
*deep breath*
*coughs blood*
My leg!
My knee!
Even with a busted leg, I'll take your head off!
I'll teach you to rip off my toes.
Wanna break my leg? Just try it!
Where's a damn tourniquet when you need one?
Son of a... What did you do to my leg?!
Step closer if you're not a coward.
Gonna take me a month to recover from this.
Guess I'm bed-bound for a while.
I'm not down yet, so don't get comfy.
You wrecked my leg, you bastard!
Need something to lean on here.
Hold on! We're not finished!
Step closer...
Just wait till I get my hands on you...
Can't feel my leg... You son of a...
You're paying for this leg and then some.
This injury's on your conscience!
This injury ain't going away quietly.
You bloody sadist!
I'll teach you to aim for the eyes!
Worthless piece of trash!
Damn it, that's the worst pain in my life!
You bastard, I can't see a thing!
That was a really painful spot!
You scum! Keep your hands off my eyes!
Just try that again...
I'm going blind! I'm going blind!!!
You'll pay for this... WITH YOUR LIFE!
Cowardly move!
Ah! How am I gonna live now?
What the hell are you doing, you scumbag?!
Only a worthless jerk like you would aim there.
You're not doing that again! You hear me?!
This has gone too far!
You're gonna pay dearly for your tricks.
I'll lynch you personally for this.
I'll feel this in the morning.
Spineless worm! That all you got?
Help!
Somebody, help me out!
This has gone too far.
Leave me alone!
Pick on someone else!
I'm not messing with you!
I'm not dying over this!
Stop torturing me!
For God's sake, just leave me alone!
Ah crap, time to bail!
We'll meet again, scumbag!
Next time, luck'll be on my side.
Hold on a sec...
I've got urgent business to attend to...
You'll pay for this, but later!
You got lucky... this time.
Better to live now and fight later.
I'll be back!
cs: Já se vrátím! A se mnou příjde...

en: We'll do this again soon!
See you around!
Grab him, don't let him get away!
Catch that skag!
Aha! It's on now!
Bad luck running into me, huh?
You're gonna shut up for good!
Never met a real pro, have you?
You're not gonna like this, but I sure will.
This is gonna hurt. For you.
Why don't you all just drop dead already?!
You'll regret stepping foot here!
Now you'll know who the best is.
Better drop dead right now!
Who the hell do you think you are?!
Time to end you once and for all!
Let's see how much you can scream from pain.
I hope it hurts real bad.
I hate you and all your kind!
Now it's curtains for you!
Get the hell outta here!
I'm getting real tired of dealing with you.
Take that, you son of a...!
Hey, I'm starting to enjoy this!
Take that, you bastard spawn of a whore!
I'll tear you to pieces!
You scum!
That's how we deal with pests around here!
Die, you maggot!
You annoying piece of crap!
I'm sick of the likes of you!
Feels good to land a punch back!
Sometimes, you gotta get what's coming to you.
You asked for it!
You mutated freak!
I hope this hurts like hell!
This'll teach you to stick your nose where it don't belong.
No one will hear from you again!
You're finished!
Oh yeah, there's a nasty side in me!
Feel real pain, you filthy scum!
I've always wanted to do this!
You aiming at me? Try that again, I dare you...
Oh, hold me back, or I'll commit a crime right here!
So, bastard, didn't work out, did it?
You're playing the wrong game.
*flips the bird*
Ha-ha. You're such a loser!
Surrender, you sack of crap.
You'll break your teeth on me.
Ptooey! And I was scared of this wuss?
Ha-ha, you're just a piece of shit!
Not too bad for a waste of space.
You think too much of yourself.
Pathetic.
You're just a two-bit crook.
Is this your first time, kid?
You're nothing but a fraud.
And I thought we were in for a fight.
Is that your best shot?
I won't be your victim.
Born a loser, die a loser.
Ouch! That hurts!
M-my teeth ache.
B-bah!
I'll replace my broken teeth with yours!
This scar will adorn my head.
Ooh, the Shady Sands call my mind.
Evil spirits muddle my thoughts.
Ugh, where am I?
Darkness shrouds my mind.
I hear so many voices...
Oof!
Bloodthirsty outsider!
My arm hurts.
Fingers won't obey.
This is bad, can't fight like this.
I need a bandage.
I'll have to fight with my feet.
Even one-handed, I'm dangerous.
Dark spirit perched on my shoulder.
One hand is enough to take your life.
Spirits of the Wastes, have mercy!
My brothers will avenge me.
I'll never see our village again.
Ancestors, I come.
Brothers, send my remains to the village.
An outsider has taken my soul.
The shaman was right, I won't return.
Desert outsider is killing me.
I don't want to be shamed after death.
I'll still see my homeland savanna.
Spirits of my life are leaving me.
The spirit of the wasteland calls me.
Suddenly it's warm and I want to sleep.
Your pain will be greater.
The shaman will praise me for this.
And your magic works.
My ancestors call me.
Ancestors laugh at me.
Need to show this to the shaman.
This scar will prove my bravery.
I hear the call of the ancestors.
No, grandfather's spirit, it's not time to die.
Better go home, outsider.
My death changes nothing for you.
This pain is strong.
Dark spirit takes my breath away.
Do all in your tribe fight like this?
Oof...
Our enemy uses strong magic.
Flesh for flesh.
I can't feel my legs.
Evil spirits have bound my legs.
Evil spirits hold me to the ground.
Your tricks won't save you.
Something stops my legs from moving.
My legs are in pain.
Never liked shaman dances anyway.
Dark spirit grabbed my leg.
Hard to dance with the shaman now.
Bloodthirsty outsider!
Sad I won't see my camp again.
The darkness calls me.
You take my eyes, but not my courage.
That's why we don't trust pale-faces.
Today darkness comes early.
Seems demons made an eclipse.
You take an eye, I take a life.
Though I don't see, spirits guide my weapon.
Are the spirits watching me?
Bloodthirsty outsider!
Why is the ground beneath me warm?
You fight without honor.
Holy spirits, the world just exploded.
cs: Svatý duchu, svět vybuchnul v bolesti!

en: I'll gut you like a pig rat for this.
All outsiders are dishonorable.
No shaman can heal this.
Ay-yi-yi!
These demons are craftier than I thought.
Pale-faces are sly and deceitful.
You bring sorrow to women.
That's an Old World Demon! Run!
Dark Demon of Ruins wants to punish us!
Maybe you're protected by the Dark Demon of Ruins.
Spirits of the Wastes, help me!
Spirit of the Dust Storm, deceive my enemies!
O Spirit of the Sealed Vault, protect me!
Demon of Nuclear Fusion, give me strength!
May the invisible Demon of Radiation strike you!
Kill me and your kin will be cursed.
Other warriors will laugh at me.
Spirits whispered me a path to retreat.
Ancestors say to retreat.
This wasn't in the prophecy.
Spirits beg me to flee.
Your face brings terror.
Dark spirit here! Run!
This man hosts a Desert Demon.
I return to camp with shame.
Shaman warned not to enter Forbidden Lands...
Better return to the Lead Farms.
Your defeat will bring me great glory.
I'll scalp you for respect!
I'll eat your heart and grow stronger!
Spirits of the Great War be with me!
Spirits are with me!
Your strength becomes mine.
I'll disgrace your clan!
The wind will dry your bones!
Let our weapons speak!
We are true warriors!
Eating your heart will make me braver.
My victory will be remembered long.
I walk the path of war.
My blade burns with thirst.
Your spirits won't help you.
I'll bring your head as a gift to the priestess.
Spirits of the Great War are with me!
Descendants will sing of my victory.
Let our blades speak to each other.
Only cowards use fire sticks.
Your spirit will be no more.
I'll make a talisman from your teeth!
Battle brew makes me stronger!
Now our clan will be feared!
Ancestors, guide my weapon!
You'll be food for wolves!
I'll sacrifice you to the god of Windmills.
God of war demands a sacrifice.
Die, pale-face!
Tell others these lands are ours now!
Dance the dance of death!
Die for our clan.
Death walks the land!
This fight will be short.
Warrior is tempered in battle.
Calm down, evil demon.
I'm not afraid of you, demon!
Outsider has no place on our land.
Surrender, it will ease your fate.
Aiya!
Spirits helped me with this.
Praise spirits of the desert wind!
Praise spirits that diverted the blow.
I'll gut you!
The potion really works!
My battle song works!
Your worm devours you.
See how fear kills the mind.
Your eyes clouded with hate.
Your spirits abandoned you.
Your attack is weak, and your spirit weaker.
Is your whole clan this weak?
You have thin blood.
Our children fight better!
You're as weak as one struck by the Demon of Radiation.
Pathetic enemy. No honor in killing you.
Ha! The spirits have left the outsider.
The strength of your life is fading.
Blame your spirits for this.
Don't worry, I'll hide your shame.

You desert rat!
Goodbye, scum!
Dirty raiders!
Damn freeloaders!
We've put up with them for too long!
Get out!
Get out, you damned gringos!
We have our own ways here!
Someone needs to teach you a lesson.
No one will bury you here.
This is my land!
You've overstayed your welcome!
Time to visit your ancestors!
Get off our land!
Surprised, huh?!

Let's hang them on a tree!

Go to hell!

Arrrr!

Arrrrr!

Grrrrrrr!

Aah! My knee!
Aah! My leg!

en: «Everything's spinning like a merry-go-round!»
«Ouch, that hurt more than a breakup!»
«One star... two stars... hope I don't hit five!»
«My beautiful face! Nooo!»
«I think I'm going to pass out... or maybe take a nap...»
«Right on the noggin! Bullseye!»
«Oh, my poor, aching head!»
«Feels like my skull is splitting... or just really disagreeing with me!»
«Well, there goes another tooth! The Tooth Fairy's gonna be rich!»
«What? How long was I out? Did I miss lunch?»
«Ah! That's not what I signed up for!»
«My hand! My precious hand!»
«Argh, my hand! Did someone catch that on camera?»
«Man, that stings worse than a breakup text!»
«My arm hurts. Like, seriously bad.»
«My arm hurts. I need a doctor, stat!»
«My whole arm looks like a pretzel!»
«Broken here... and here... oh, just great.»
«You broke my arm! Who's paying for this?»
«Ahh, they broke my arm! You're on my naughty list!»
«I can't feel my hand! Did it clock out early?»
«Won't someone fix my hand? Pretty please with sugar on top!»
«My finger got blown off! Stop the chaos, seriously!»
«Stop! How am I supposed to feed my family without a hand?»
«Please leave at least a couple of fingers! I need those!»
«My fingers are going numb... is this how Frosty felt?»
«Hey, check out what you did to your hand!»
«Too much blood! Someone get me a bandage, ASAP!»
«A bit more, and I'd be waving goodbye to my hand!»
«This hurts so bad... I thought pain had limits!»
«Why are you doing this to me? Do I owe you money or something?»
«What's that poking out of my chest? That's not normal, right?»
«Ribs! That really, really hurt!»
«I can't breathe right... is this what fish feel like?»
«This looks like trouble with a capital T.»
«It doesn't hurt much, but I'm losing enough blood to fill a kiddie pool!»
«You're footing the medical bill for this, buddy!»
«Doctors, to the rescue!»
«This wound is giving me dangerous vibes!»
«Why won't my back straighten? Did I turn into a question mark?»
«I think something broke inside me... hope it's not my will to live!»
«*coughs blood* This can't be good.»
«Whose blood is this? Hope it's not mine!»
«I should probably lie down until this bleeding stops.»
«Breathing is hard... am I under water or something?»
«I won't do anything crazy, just don't kill me!»
«That's a lot of blood... is there a vampire convention nearby?»
«Getting warm... and sleepy... time for a nap?»
«*heavy breath* That was my dramatic sigh.»
«Can't...breathe... gotta catch my breath!»
«I think I'm... dying... or just really tired.»
«Help me! Somebody, save me!»
«Don't kill me, I have a family! And I'm an artist!»
«Owww, my chest feels like it's on fire!»
hint_cs: Metafora bolesti/tepla — ne bojový stav „v plamenech“.

en: «Wait... gotta catch my breath...»
«Hold on, I need to count my ribs.»
«At least let me have one last smoke before I kick the bucket.»
«Ugh, I really need to quit smoking after this.»
«My lungs took a coffee break.»
«One less rib, hope it wasn't important!»
«My leg! I need that for walking!»
«Ouch, my knee is screaming louder than my ex!»
«I think it's gone... Aah! The pain!»
«Blood is leaking from my boot... it's not a fashion statement!»
«I can't feel my foot! Did it go on vacation?»
«I think I got shot in the leg... just my luck!»
«My leg is MIA!»
«Call a doctor! I'm stuck like a statue!»
«Stop it before I turn into a complete cripple!»
«You better pay for my leg's treatment, pal!»
«Hey, cut it out!»
«I can't walk anymore! Thanks for that!»
«It hurts to move. I'm not cut out for this!»
«I was shot in the leg. Can someone write me a sick note?»
«My knee is wrecked. Who's paying for this?»
«This injury is totally on your conscience!»
«Great, I'll be rocking crutches for the next few months.»
«I don't want to be a cripple!»
«Who needs a one-legged person now?»
«No leg, no life, and it's all YOUR fault!»
«My eyes! My precious eyes!»
«Oh no, my eye!»
«Be careful, or I'll go blind!»
«I can't see anything! Did someone turn off the lights?»
«Not the face! It's my best feature!»
«If I go blind, it's on you!»
«I'm going blind! Nooo!»
«Hey, you hurt my eye!»
«It's getting dark in here... is there a blackout?»
«I'll give anything to not go blind!»
«Shame on you!»
«What kind of monster are you?»
«Is this your idea of fun? Really?»
«Oh, the pain, the pain!»
«Uh-oh! That can't be good.»
«Damn, that stings!»
«Only a real jerk would do this!»
«Where the heck are you aiming?!»
«There go my plans for kids.»
«With this injury, say goodbye to all my plans.»
«Help! I'm being murdered!»
«Somebody, help me!»
«I've had enough of this nonsense!»
«Please, no more!»
«Please, just stop!»
«Just leave us alone, okay?»
«I don't want to die! I've got stuff to do!»
«You're not going to kill me, right?»
«Please, don't hit me again!»
«Sorry, but I've got to run.»
«Damn, I thought you'd be easier to deal with.»
«Can't you pick on someone else?»
«I'm not coming back here, ever.»
«Please, stop hurting me!»
«It's just not worth it, seriously.»
«Holy crap! I'm outta here!»
«No way! I'm getting out of here!»
«Sorry! Didn't mean to bother you!»
«I never wanted to fight you!»
«If you let me go, I'll leave, I swear!»
«I don't want the neighbors to see me dealing with you.»
«Stay still, and I'll make this quick.»
«This won't take long, promise.»
«Stop that jerk!»
«I don't think you're going to like this.»
«Now it's my turn to have some fun.»
«Time for a little dance, shall we?»
«I really don't want to do this, but you leave me no choice.»
«You're really getting on my nerves.»
«Somebody needs to teach you some manners.»
«I'm getting pretty tired of this.»
«It's a shame it had to come to this...»
«Why does it always come to this?»
«Just go away, and no one gets hurt.»
«Because of parasites like you, honest folks can't catch a break.»
«I don't want to kill anyone else. Please don't make me.»
«I really hope nobody's going to miss you.»
«Someone's going to pay for all this.»
«Nobody wants you here.»
«I hope this doesn't backfire on me.»
«Take that! How do you like them apples?»
«Take that!»
«How does that feel? Not good, right?»
«Yeah, take that!»
«How do you like that?»
«Oh yeah, right there!»
«Uh-oh, looks like someone's bleeding!»
«Yeah, step right up for the next hit!»
«How do you like that? Not fun, huh?»
«Ha, enjoy that? Didn't think so!»
«Time for a little nap!»
«Take that! And that! And that!»
«Take that, you had it coming!»
«Now you've got me really ticked off!»
«Don't make me do this again.»
«Hope that hurts!»
«This'll teach you some manners.»
«You won't be hurting anyone else!»
«This is just the beginning of your lesson!»
«It's only going to get worse from here!»
«Hey, you almost hit me!»
«Damn raiders!»
«This is just chaos!»
«Stop, someone's going to get hurt!»
«You could kill someone with that!»
«Why are you doing this? Looking for trouble?»
«If you're looking for trouble, find it somewhere else.»
«Just a bit more...»
«Looks like you were more bark than bite.»
«Don't you dare try that again.»
«You missed! Let's call it quits.»
«You're not going to hit me!»
«You're a terrible fighter.»
«Go back to your cave, savage.»
«Better stay home and keep your head down.»
«Am I bleeding? No? Phew!»
«Phew, that was close...»
«Good thing I'm quick on my feet!»
«Okay, okay, I'll dance! Just leave me alone!»
«Hey, watch it!»

Karma

Perks add additional abilities. Every third experience level, you can choose one perk.
ru: Способности прибавляют дополнительные качества. На каждом третьем уровне вы можете выбрать одну способность.
cs: Speciální schopnosti. Nový perk získáš každou třetí úroveň.

en: These are the effects of the choices you make during the game.
ru: Здесь отображается влияние решений, которые вы принимаете во время игры.
cs: Vliv tvých rozhodnutí učiněných během hry.

en: A counter that keeps track of the type and numbers of creatures you have slaughtered, or have seen killed in your presence.
ru: Счетчик, отображающий тип и количество убитых вами существ или существ, которых убили ваши спутники.
cs: Počítadlo zaznamenávající typ a počet stvoření, která zemřela v tvé blízkosti nebo byla tebou zabita.

en: Skill Points
Use free skill points to increase the level of a skill.  As you get better at a given skill, however, it takes more points to raise that skill.  Mastering a skill can take a lot of time and effort.
ru: Дополнительные очки навыков можно использовать для повышения навыка. Чем лучше вы владеете навыком, тем больше очков понадобится для его повышения.
cs: Volné dovednostní body můžeš použít ke zvýšení úrovně některé ze schopností.  Jak se bude tvá postava postupně zdokonalovat, bude tě i každé nové procento stát více dovednostních bodů.

en: Not enough skill points available.
Base:
TAG SKILLS
OPTIONAL TRAITS
Tag Skills
Tag skills are skills your character specializes in.  Each tag skill gains +20%, and increases twice as fast.  You must pick three tag skills.
ru: Навыки, на которых специализируется ваш персонаж. Каждый основной навык получает +20% в начале и увеличивается в два раза быстрее. Необходимо выбрать три основных навыка.
cs: Talenty jsou schopnosti, na které se tvá postava specializuje.  U každého talentu získá postava do začátku bonus +20% a zároveň se v něm zdokonaluje dvojnásobně rychle.  Musíš vybrat tři.

en: Optional Traits
Optional traits describe your character in more detail.  All traits will have positive and negative effects.  You may choose up to two traits during creation.
ru: Дополнительные особенности - штрихи к портрету вашего персонажа.  Все особенности имеют положительное или отрицательное влияние. Вы можете выбрать максимум две особенности во время создания персонажа.
cs: Charakterové rysy popisují tvou postavu do větších podrobností.  Každý z nich má pozitivní i negativní efekt. Během tvorby postavy si musíš zvolit dva.

en: Skills
Skills are learned knowledge.  Skills increase by experience, or during the course of the game by special events.  The higher the skill level, the better you are at that skill.
ru: Навыки - приобретенное знание. Навыки увеличиваются с опытом, а также с помощью особых игровых событий. Чем выше уровень навыка, тем лучше вы им владеете.
cs: Dovednosti jsou vytrénované schopnosti. Dovednosti se zlepšují zkušenostmi nebo speciálními událostmi během hry. Čím je dovednost vyšší, tím je tvá postava v daném oboru lepší.

cs: Tvá levá ruka je vážně zraněna - nemůžeš s ní normálně pohybovat. Pokud je zraněna jen jedna ruka, nemůžeš používat obouruční zbraně. Pokud obě, nemůžeš používat vůbec žádnou zbraň.

This is a ranged stat that represents your general reputation. The higher the number, the better known and respected you are. If your rep is negative, you are hated by some for your evil actions.
cs: Tato položka reprezentuje tvoji obecnou reputaci. Čím je číslo vyšší, tím jsi známější a uznávanější. Pokud je tvá reputace negativní, lidé tě nenávidí pro tvé zločiny.

en: You have killed a large number of people. This is generally not a good thing to get known for. People from the wrong side of the track will like you a little more, however.
cs: Zabil jsi spoustu lidí. A to není moc dobrý způsob, jak se proslavit. Lidé z podsvětí si tě ale váží a respektují tě.

en: Your actions have revealed you to be a champion of the people. Your war against evil and villainy is widely known. Honorable people will respect you better.
cs: Tvé činy z tebe udělali šampióna. Tvůj boj se zlem a hanebností je všeobecně známý. Čestní lidé si tě váží a uznávají tě.

en: You thoroughly enjoy Nuka-Cola, the pop of the post-nuclear world.
cs: Umíš si důkladně vychutnat Nuka-Colu, nealko-nápoj postnukleárního světa. Možná až moc důkladně.

en: You are addicted to the drug Buffout. You must take this drug on an ongoing basis or suffer the effects of withdrawal.
You are suffering from Mentat addiction. You must take this particular drug or suffer withdrawal.
You have a drug addiction. If you do not take Psycho on a regular schedule, you will suffer. If you do, others will suffer.
Your body has become addicted to RadAway. While not life threatening, you must take it regularly.
cs: Tvoje tělo potřebuje stálý přísun chemikálie Radaway. Nijak tě to sice neohrožuje na životě, nicméně ji musíš brát pravidelně.

en: You have a problem with alcohol. Actually, you have many problems with your drinking habits.
cs: Máš menší problém s alkoholem. No, vlastně je to spíš větší problém.

en: You have a drug addiction. You must take Jet on a regular basis.
Tragically, you are addicted to the Garnering. You are constantly in search of new expansions.
cs: Bohužel, už je to tak. Jsi závislý na karetní hře "Tragic the Garnering". Cítíš neustálé nutkání shánět nové a nové sady karet.

en: You have killed children, the youth of the wasteland. This is considered to be a really bad thing. You evil, evil person.
cs: Co ti k tomu mám říct? Zabíjíš nevinné a neozbrojené děti. Chceš opravdu slyšet, co si o tobě myslíme?

en: You've killed a lot of people. And you did it with style. Not everyone likes people like you, even in a post-nuclear world.
You are a born hunter. You've butchered so many wild animals that you've lost count.
You kill mutants. Cleansing the modern world from all kinds of mutants has become your calling. Some people admire you, others, you frighten.
You have reached level 12, and very few people (or even none) have died due to your fault. With such an outlook on life, it is a miracle that you yourself are still alive.
You have joined the Brotherhood of Steel. Although your training is not yet complete, this already says a lot about your capabilities.

Your relentless dedication and unwavering service have significantly advanced the mission of the Brotherhood of Steel. In recognition of your exemplary efforts, the Elders bestow upon you the esteemed title of Accomplished Scribe.

Through your unwavering commitment and remarkable contributions, you have greatly furthered the Brotherhood's cause. As a testament to your achievements, the Elders honor you with the distinguished rank of Accomplished Knight.

Your valor and steadfast service have proven invaluable in advancing the Brotherhood's mission. In acknowledgment of your exceptional contributions, the Elders elevate you to the honored rank of Accomplished Paladin.

With your exceptional skills and relentless determination, you have made significant strides in advancing the goals of the Brotherhood. The Elders, in recognition of your outstanding service, confer upon you the respected title of Accomplished Scout.
You betrayed the Brotherhood of Steel after all they did for you. The Brotherhood does not forgive this. Never.
You have officially been accepted into the ranks of the Rangers. Now it is your responsibility to create order in the Wasteland.
The Church of the Holy Fire has accepted you into its narrow circle of initiates. Few have succeeded.
The Highwaymen now consider you one of their own and are ready to come to your aid from now on.
You are now a runaway slave. You will have to constantly hide from your pursuers until you manage to obtain your freedom from your slave owner.
You... have transformed. You've become a new person. This makes you see yourself in a new light. And the entire world around you.
You have rejected progress in favor of maintaining tradition. By doing this, you have inspired the people of the Villa and proven your dedication to the ideals of the community.
You have rejected tradition in favor of progress. You have your reasons, but most of the Villa's residents are unlikely to agree with you on this issue.
You are the heavyweight champion of Phoenix. You have gained fame, respect and love from thousands of fans.

Everyone in this area would like to be you. You're the toast-of-the-town and are held up as a shining example of all that a person can be.
cs: Tady by se ti chtěl každý podobat. Jsi miláčkem města a pro všechny zářným příkladem a ukázkou toho, jak vypadá opravdový hrdina.

en: People wave, and greet you, wherever you go in this area. Everyone has heard talk of you, and they like what they've heard.
cs: Lidé tě vítají a oslavují, kdykoliv jen vejdeš na toto místo. Všichni  o tobě slyšeli a všem se to, co slyšeli, moc líbilo.

en: Although, you're not greeted with open arms, most people in this area will at least nod in acknowledgment when you meet. You fit in as well as most.
cs: Ačkoliv nejsi vítán přímo s otevřenou náručí, většina lidí ti v tomto místě na pozdrav odpoví. Nejsi pro ně ničím zvlášť výjimečným.

en: Though normally suspicious of strangers, the people of this area haven't made up their minds about you yet.
cs: Ačkoliv jsou obvykle vůči cizincům podezřívaví, proti tobě lidé na tomto místě nic nemají. Zatím.

en: You're just another out-of-towner in this area. Probably up to no good.
cs: Pro lidi v tomhle místě jsi jen dalším cizincem. Nutno dodat, že nijak zvlášť vítaným.

en: You've proven to the people in this area that their initial distrust was well founded. People in this area look at you and mutter to one another when you come near. They know you're up to no good.
cs: Lidem na tomto místě jsi dokázal, že jejich počáteční odpor vůči tobě, byl víc než oprávněný. Všichni zmlknou, když se k nim přiblížíš. Už tě znají.

en: Staring and muttering, some cross the street to avoid walking near you, while others, spit and turn away when you come near. Everyone knows that you're one of the worst things that's ever slithered into this area.
