With Awareness, you are given detailed information about any critter you examine.  You see their exact hit points and information about any weapon they are equipped with.
ru: Отточенная наблюдательность дает вам возможность замечать некоторые детали о любом существе, на которое вы смотрите: точное количество очков здоровья, оружие и тип боеприпасов в нем.
cs: Dokážeš postřehnout víc detailů o lidech okolo.  Když někoho prozkoumáš, VŠÍMAVOST ti o něm poskytne víc podrobnějších informací.  Zjistíš, čím je ozbrojen i přesný počet jeho hit bodů.

en: You have learned the secret arts of the East, or you just punch faster.  In any case, your Hand-to-Hand attacks cost 1 AP less to perform.
ru: Вы в совершенстве изучили приемы боевых искусств, поэтому теперь для вас атака руками или холодным оружием стоит на 1 ОД меньше.
cs: Buď jsi studoval tajná bojová umění Východu nebo prostě jen dokážeš udeřit rychleji. V každém případě tě tvoje údery při boji zblízka stojí o 1 akční bod méně.

en: Experience in unarmed combat has given you the edge when it comes to damage.  You cause +2 points of damage with hand-to-hand and melee attacks for each level of this Perk.
ru: Вы оттачиваете свое боевое мастерство в сторону нанесения большего урона. Каждый уровень этой способности позволяет вам наносить на 2 очка урона больше при рукопашной атаке.
cs: Tvoje zkušenosti v boji zblízka z tebe udělaly pěkně ostrého protivníka. Za každý stupeň tohoto Perku způsobíš soupeři při boji beze zbraně a boji chladnými zbraněmi o 2 body poškození víc.

en: For each level of Bonus Move, you get 2 free APs each turn that can only be used for movement.  In other words, you can move 2 free hexes each turn for each level of this Perk.
ru: Пустоши научили вас быстро убегать от противников. Теперь у вас есть 2 дополнительных ОД в бою, но их можно использовать только для передвижения.
cs: Za každý stupeň tohoto Perku dostaneš ve svém tahu o 2 akční body víc. Tyto body ale mohou být využity pouze pro pohyb.  Jinými slovy za každý level tohoto Perku se ve svém tahu budeš moci pohnout o 2 hexy navíc.

en: Your training in firearms and other ranged weapons has made you more deadly in ranged combat.  For each level of this Perk, you do +2 points of damage with ranged weapons.
ru: Опыт обращения со стрелковым оружием сделал вас экспертом по дальнему бою. Каждый уровень этой способности увеличивает урон от стрелкового оружия на 2 очка (для каждого патрона).
cs: Tvůj trénink v boji na dlouhou vzdálenost (střelné zbraně apod.) z tebe dělá smrtelně nebezpečného protivníka. Za každou úroveň tohoto Perku způsobíš o 2 body poškození víc.

en: This Perk allows you to pull the trigger a little faster and still remain as accurate as before.  Each ranged weapon attack costs 1 AP less to perform.
ru: Эта способность позволяет вам нажимать на курок немного быстрее, не теряя при этом точности. Каждая атака при использовании оружия дальнего действия стоит на 1 ОД меньше.
cs: Tento Perk ti umožní zmáčknout spoušť o něco rychleji a přesto střílet stejně přesně jako předtím. Používání zbraní pro boj na dlouhou vzdálenost tě stojí o jeden akční bod méně.

en: You are more likely to move before your opponents in combat, since your Sequence is +2 for each level of this Perk.
ru: У вас больше шансов опередить противников во время боя, так как каждый уровень этой способности повышает вашу Реакцию на 2 очка.
cs: V boji jsi schopen reagovat rychleji než tvoji nepřátelé, protože tvůj Postřeh je +2 za každý stupeň tohoto Perku.

en: With each level of this Perk, you get a +2 bonus to your Healing Rate.  This is in addition to your normal healing rate, thus you heal faster.
ru: Вы следите за своим здоровьем, поэтому получаете дополнительно 2 очка к скорости исцеления. А это значит, что ваше здоровье отныне будет восстанавливаться быстрее.
cs: S každým stupněm tohoto Perku, obdržíš +2 bonus ke své schopnosti Uzdravit se. Čili -- uzdravuješ se rychleji.

en: You are more likely to cause critical hits in combat if you have this Perk.  Each level of More Criticals gets you an additional +5% chance to cause a critical hit.
ru: В бою вы стали более расчетливы. Каждый уровень этой способности повышает ваши шансы нанести критический удар на 5%. А это не мало.
cs: Pokud máš tento Perk, máš větší šanci způsobit v boji soupeři kritický zásah. Každý stupeň ti přidá +5% šanci na kritický zásah.  To docela ujde, ne?

en: With the Night Vision Perk, you can see in the dark better.  This will reduce the overall darkness level by 20%.
ru: Благодаря ночному образу жизни ваши глаза адаптировались к темноте. Это не только разгоняет тьму вокруг, но также повышает точность дальнобойного оружия в бою на 15%.
cs: S tímto Perkem vidíš ve tmě lépe. Tento Perk zredukuje okolní temnotu o 20%.

en: You can temporarily calm a wild animal by feeding it. Each rank makes this process quicker.
ru: Позволяет ненадолго присмирить неразумное животное, если его покормить. С каждым рангом этот процесс ускоряется.

en: You are better able to avoid radiation and the bad effects radiation causes.  Each level of this Perk improves your Radiation Resistance by 15%.
ru: У вас больше шансов избежать радиационного поражения и его последствий. Каждый уровень этой способности повышает вашу сопротивляемость радиации на 15%.
cs: Lépe odoláváš radioaktivitě a jejím zhoubným následkům. Každý level tohoto Perku ti přidá 15% na Odolnosti proti radiaci.

en: When you are tough, you take less damage.  Each level of this Perk adds +10% to your general damage resistance.
ru: Непробиваемость уменьшает наносимый вам урон. Каждый уровень этой способности повышает вашу общую сопротивляемость урону на 10%.
cs: Jsi-li houževnatý, utrpěná zranění tě méně poškozují. Každý level tohoto Perk ti dodá +10% ke tvé celkové Odolnosti proti poškození.

en: AKA Mule.  You can carry an additional 50 pounds of equipment for each level of this Perk.
ru: Каждый уровень этой способности увеличивает вашу грузоподъемность на 50 фунтов.
cs: Máš sílu jako mezek. Za každý stupeň tohoto Perku uneseš o 50 liber vybavení víc.

en: You have a talent for hitting things at longer distances.  For each level of this Perk, you get a +2 bonus to Perception for the purposes of determining range modifiers.  It's easier than ever to kill at long range!
ru: Вы натренировали свою зоркость в том, что касается стрельбы по цели с большого расстояния. Каждый уровень этой способности повышает ваше восприятие на 2 в том, что касается прицеливания.
cs: Máš talent zasáhnout cíl na dlouhou vzdálenost. Za každý stupeň tohoto Perku dostaneš +2 bonus ke své schopnosti VNÍMÁNÍ vždy, když budeš bojovat na delší vzdálenost.  Zabíjet z patřičného odstupu je jednodušší!

en: With this Perk, you now have the ability to move quickly and still remain quiet.  You can Sneak and run at the same time.  Without this Perk, you would automatically stop Sneaking if you ran.
ru: Способность дает вам возможность двигаться быстро и бесшумно. То есть вы можете бежать, используя при этом скрытность (без способности скрытность отключается при беге).
cs: S tímto Perkem se můžeš pohybovat rychle a přesto tiše.  Můžeš běhat a používat PLÍŽENÍ najednou.  Bez tohoto Perku se při běhu PLÍŽENÍ automaticky zruší.

en: You are a master of the outdoors.  This Perk confers the ability to survive in hostile environments.  You get a +25% bonus to Outdoorsman.
ru: Вы научились выживать в нечеловеческих условиях дикой постъядерной Пустоши. Это повышает соответствующий навык на 25%.
cs: Jsi opravdový táborník. Tento Perk ti propůjčuje schopnost snadněji přežít v nehostinném prostředí.  Za každý level tohoto Perku dostaneš +25% bonus ke své schopnosti Zálesák.

en: You have mastered one aspect of bartering - buying goods far more cheaply than normal. With this Perk, you get a 25% discount when purchasing items from a store or another trader.
ru: Вы осваиваете один из аспектов торговли: как сбивать цену на товар. Эта способность дает вам скидку 25% при покупке товаров в магазине или у другого торговца.
cs: Speciálně jsi se vypracoval v jedné disciplíně obchodování - ve schopnosti koupit něco levněji než ostatní.  S tímto Perkem dostaneš v každém obchodě 25%-ní slevu.

en: Each level of Educated adds +2 skill points when you gain a new experience level. This Perk works best when purchased early in your adventure.
ru: Занятия в сельской школе не прошли даром. Каждый уровень этой способности дает 2 дополнительных очка навыков при получении нового уровня. Чем раньше получить Образование, тем выгоднее оно будет в будущем.
cs: Každá úroveň "Vzdělance" ti přidá 2 schopnostní body navíc k počtu, který obdržíš při dosažení nové zkušenostní úrovně.  Čím dřív si ve hře tento Perk vezmeš, tím víc se ti pochopitelně zúročí.

en: The healing of bodies comes easier to you with this Perk. Each level of this Perk heals 4-10 additional hit points when using the First Aid or Doctor skills.
ru: Вы много практиковались на животных и теперь сможете лучше лечить людей. Каждый уровень этой способности добавляет от 4 до 10 дополнительных очков здоровья при исцелении навыком.
cs: Tento Perk zvyšuje tvoje léčitelské schopnosti.  Každá jeho úroveň ti přidá 4-10 hit bodů o které se při použití schopnosti První pomoc nebo Doktor, uzdravíš více.

en: You've got a knack for unearthing treasure. Now, you'll find more valuable loot in greater quantities, and stashes will be marked on your mini-map. Plus, traders will have 10% more caps for you to barter with.
ru: У вас талант находить ценные вещи. Теперь качество и количество таких находок возрастет, а тайники будут отмечены маркерами на миникарте. К тому же у торговцев на 10% увеличится валютный оборот.
hint_cs: Měna caps → zatky, ne víčka.

en: The critical hits you cause in combat are more devastating. You gain a 20% bonus on the critical hit table, almost ensuring that more damage will be done. This does not affect the chance to cause a critical hit.
ru: Отныне вы будете наносить своими критическими ударами на 20% больше урона. Заметьте: речь идет о размере урона, а не о шансах нанесения критического удара.
cs: Kritické zásahy, které v boji způsobuješ soupeřům jsou ještě ničivější než dosud.  Obdržíš 20%-ní bonus k účinku každého kritického zásahu.  Což ovšem nemá žádný vliv na samotnou šanci kritický zásah docílit.

en: You have studied other human beings, giving you inside knowledge of their emotional reaction to you.  You will see the reaction level of the person you are talking to when involved in an in-depth conversation.
ru: Вы постоянно изучаете других людей, благодаря чему хорошо знаете, какова их эмоциональная реакция на вас. Вы увидите уровень реакции своего собеседника, если достаточно долго будете с ним разговаривать.

en: The Slayer walks the earth!  In hand-to-hand combat all of your hits are upgraded to critical hits, causing destruction and mayhem.
ru: Убийца идет по земле! В рукопашном бою все ваши удары становятся критическими, неся за собой разрушения и хаос.
cs: Conan Ničitel přišel mezi nás!  V boji beze zbraně jsou všechny tvoje zásahy povýšeny na kritické -- jsi ztělesněním smrti a destrukce.

en: You have mastered the firearm as a source of pain.  With this Perk, any successful hit in combat with a ranged weapon will be upgraded to a critical hit if you also make a Luck roll.
ru: Вы в совершенстве овладели огнестрельным оружием. Теперь шансы критического попадания для такого оружия рассчитываются по новой формуле: Удача*10%.
cs: S tímto Perkem je každý tvůj úspěšný zásah v boji na dlouhou vzdálenost, povýšen na kritický. Svou roli ovšem hraje i tvoje ŠTĚSTÍ. Doporučují 4 z 5 odstřelovačů.

en: While Sneaking, if you hit a critter in the back, you will cause double damage using a hand-to-hand attack.  Silent Death is that kind of Perk.
ru: Если при действующей Скрытности вы ударите в спину какое-либо существо, ему будет нанесен двойной урон. Вот что значит Тихая смерть.
cs: Když při Plížení zasáhneš v boji zblízka svého protivníka zezadu, bude mít tvoje rána dvojnásobný účinek, než obvykle.  Tomu se říká Tichá (a rychlá) smrt.

en: Each level of Action Boy gives you an additional AP to spend every combat turn.  You can use these generic APs on any task.
ru: Благодаря этой способности вы получаете дополнительное ОД во время хода в бою. Использовать его можно для любого действия.

en: ( Steadfast Mind in F1)
With each level of this Perk, you gain an additional 4 Hit Points every time you advance a level.  This is in addition to the hit points you already gain per level based off of your endurance.
ru: Каждый уровень этой способности дает вам 4 дополнительных очка здоровья каждый раз, как ваш уровень опыта повышается. Это помимо тех очков здоровья, которые вы получаете в зависимости от своей выносливости.
cs: Každý level tohoto Perku ti přidá 4 Hit body navíc. Možná to na první pohled vypadá, že to nic moc není, ale nemusí pršet, jen když kape.

en: You are less likely to be hit in combat if you have this Perk. You gain a +5 to your Armor Class, in addition to the AC bonus from any armor worn.
ru: Вы слишком изворотливы, чтобы в вас попасть во время боя. И поэтому получаете +5 к классу брони (помимо того бонуса, что дает сама броня).
cs: V boji je mnohem těžší tě zasáhnout, máš-li tento Perk. Každý jeho stupeň přidává +5 ke tvé Třídě zbroje, bez ohledu na typ oblečeného brnění.

en: Yum! Tastes like chicken. For each level of this Perk, you gain +25% to your Poison Resistance.
ru: Вы долгое время приучали свой организм к различным ядам и теперь они на вас не действуют. Каждый уровень этой способности дает +25% к вашей сопротивляемости ядам.
cs: Mňam! Chutnají jako pečená kuřata. Jsi imunní proti jedům, jinými slovy dostaneš +25% ke své Odolnosti proti jedům.

en: You have a deep understanding of pre-war electronics. This ability increases your Repair and Science skills by 10%.
ru: Вы отлично разбираетесь в довоенной электронике. Эта способность повышает на 10% навыки Ремонт и Наука.

en: The Medic Perk gives you a one-time bonus of +10% to the First Aid and Doctor skills.  Healing skills are a good thing.
ru: Вы изучили много факультативной литературы по медицине и теперь гораздо лучше разбираетесь в теории, повышая этим соответствующий навык на 10%. Пора применять знания на практике.
cs: Tento Perk ti dává jednorázový bonus +10% ke tvým schopnostem První pomoc a Doktor.  Umět někoho vyléčit, to se vždycky hodí.

en: A Master Thief is proficient at stealing and picking locks. You gain +15 to Stealing and Lockpicking.  Steal from the rich, and give to you.
ru: Оттачивая воровское мастерство, вы получаете +15% к Краже и Взлому. Отнять у богатых и раздать бедным - то есть вам.
cs: Perk Kapsář ti dává jednorázový bonus +15% ke tvým schopnostem Paklíč a Ukrást.  Bohatým brát a sobě dávat.

en: Being a Speaker means you have a one-time bonus of +20% to Speech.  From the mouth of babes and all that.
ru: Быть Оратором - значит приобрести одноразовый бонус +20% к Красноречию. Устами младенца и все такое.
cs: Být Spíkrem znamená, že dostaneš jednorázový bonus +20% ke své schopnosti Řeč.

en: Each level of the Heave Ho! Perk gives you an additional +2 to Strength (up to 10) for purposes of determining range with thrown weapons only. This Perk will not exceed a weapon's maximum range.
ru: Каждый уровень способности дает вам +2 к Силе (до 10) для повышения дальности броска. Она не позволит превысить максимальную дальнобойность оружия.

en: You've learned enough about motorcycle mechanics and driving techniques to hop on and ride right now. The only thing left is to find a bike that's still in one piece.
ru: Вы узнали достаточно об устройстве мотоцикла и особенностях его вождения, чтобы прямо сейчас браться за руль. Осталась самая малость - найти уцелевший байк.

en: You are much more adept at stealing than the normal crook. You can steal with the best of them, because with this Perk, you ignore size and facing modifiers when stealing from a person.
ru: Ловкость ваших рук поражает даже заядлых воришек. Вы можете украсть что угодно, потому что теперь размер вещи и направление взгляда жертвы не имеют значения при краже.
cs: Jsi mistr zlodějského řemesla.  Můžeš se směle zařadit po bok těch nejlepších kapsářů, protože s tímto Perkem lze ignorovat velikost a polohu okrádaného subjektu.

en: When the sun goes down or you are in a poorly lit area, you move like a ghost with this Perk.  Your Sneak skill is enhanced +20% in dark conditions.
ru: После захода солнца или в плохо освещенных местах при помощи этой способности вы передвигаетесь как призрак. Ваш навык Скрытности увеличивается в темноте на 20%.
cs: Máš-li tento Perk, pak tvoje chvíle přichází po západu slunce nebo ve špatně osvětlených prostorách. Můžeš se pohybovat neslyšně jako duch.  Tvoje schopnost Plížení se ve tmě zvyšuje o +20%.

en: The Wasteland's memory is short; your deeds, whether noble or vile, have faded to dust. Your karma and some titles are now wiped clean.
ru: Население Пустошей забыло о ваших деяниях, поэтому ваша слава (и дурная, и добрая) вновь на нуле. Это касается также некоторых титулов.

en: ( Flea dealer in F1)
Thanks to this ability, you can continue your journey after completing your main mission.
ru: Благодаря этой способности вы сможете продолжать путешествие после завершения своей главной миссии.

en: You have completed a treatment course for drug addiction. This perk reduces your chances of becoming addicted to chemicals by 50%, and withdrawal will last half as long.
ru: Вы прошли курс лечения от наркотической зависимости. Эта способность снижает на 50% ваши шансы пристраститься к химикатам, а ломка будет длиться вдвое меньше.

en: The Pathfinder is better able to find the shortest route.  With this Perk, your travel time on the World Map is reduced by 25% for each level.
ru: Вы научились правильно выбирать дорогу и экономить силы в пути. Поэтому время путешествия по мировой карте сокращается на 25% (для каждого ранга способности).
cs: Máš-li při svém dobrodružství Průvodce, najdeš vždy tu nejkratší cestu. S tímto Perkem se tvůj cestovní čas po mapě světa Falloutu redukuje o 25% za každý jeho level.

en: You've been exposed to a mysterious virus and intense radiation. Soon, this will lead to irreversible changes in your body, transforming you into... something else.
ru: Вы подверглись совместному воздействию неизвестного вируса и мощной радиации. Вскоре это приведет к необратимым последствиям для вашего организма, и вы станете другим... человеком.

en: You have improved your ability to see distant locations, increasing the size of explorations on the World Map by one square in each direction.  You also have a better chance of finding special encounters.
ru: Вы тщательно исследуете местность по старым картам и с высоких позиций. Эта способность вдвое увеличивает дальность зрения на мировой карте и шансы необычных встреч.
cs: Získal jsi schopnost dohlédnout i na vzdálenější lokace. Při svých cestách po mapě Falloutu odkrýváš v každém směru o jeden čtverec víc. Máš rovněž větší šanci najít speciální lokace.

en: With this Perk, you have gained the attention of a Mysterious Stranger, who will appear to help you from time to time.  If your ally is lost in combat, do not expect him (or her) to be replaced.
ru: Эта способность привлекает к вам внимание загадочного незнакомца, который будет время от времени появляться, чтобы помочь вам во время случайных встреч. Если он погибнет в бою, не думайте, что его заменят.
cs: S tímto Perkem jsi upoutal pozornost Tajemného cizince, který ti čas od času pomůže. Jestliže bude ale tento tvůj spojenec zabit v bitvě, nečekej, že ho (nebo ji) někdo nahradí.

en: You've traveled enough to develop a special intuition. This ability increases your Outdoorsman skill by 15% and halves the background radiation exposure in locations.
ru: Вы достаточно много путешествовали, чтобы у вас выработалась особая интуиция. Эта способность повышает навык выживания на 15% и вдвое снижает частоту фонового облучения на локациях.

en: You have learned to pack your equipment better.  Accessing your inventory only costs you 2 Action Points in Combat instead of 4.
ru: Вы научились как следует паковать свои вещи. Доступ к снаряжению во время боя теперь стоит всего 2 очка действий вместо 4.
cs: Naučil ses lépe uspořádat svoje vybavení.  V bojovém módu tě stojí vstup do inventáře namísto 4 jen 2 akční body.

en: You have learned to increase your dialog options without understanding what you're talking about.  Each level of this Perk will increase your Intelligence by one (up to 10) for purposes of dialog only.
ru: Вы научились вести содержательный диалог, не понимая, о чем идет речь. На время разговора вы получаете +1 к Интеллекту, что расширяет выбор вопросов и ответов.

en: You are indeed a Swift Learner with this Perk, as each level gives you an additional +5% bonus whenever you earn experience points.  This is best taken early.
ru: Вы схватываете налету, поэтому быстро учитесь. Каждый уровень этой способности добавляет к получаемому опыту 5%. Чем раньше усвоите этот урок, тем больше пользы он успеет принести.
cs: S tímto Perkem jsi opravdu Bystrý učedník, protože každý jeho level ti dává +5% bonus, kdykoliv ve hře obdržíš zkušenostní body.  Čím dřív si Perk vezmeš, tím víc se ti pochopitelně zúročí.

en: Your skills have improved to the point where you can pick an additional Tag Skill.  Tag skills increase twice as fast.
ru: Вы достигли такого уровня, при котором можете выбрать еще один основной навык. Основные навыки растут в два раза быстрее.
cs: Tvoje zkušenosti dospěly k bodu, kdy si můžeš vzít další Talent. U této vybrané schopnosti dostaneš za každý bod, který do ní investuješ, dvojnásobek procent než u ostatních schopností.

en: The radiation of the wasteland has changed you!  One of your Traits has mutated into something else...
ru: Радиация пустоши изменила вас! Одна из ваших особенностей превратилась во что-то другое...
cs: Zbytková radioaktivita v Pustině způsobila tvojí mutaci! Jeden z tvých talentů se změnil na jiný a ty si můžeš vybrat, který to bude...

en: You're "hooked" on Nuka-Cola. You need to consume this drink to avoid withdrawal.
ru: Вы "подсели" на ядер-колу. Вам необходимо принимать этот напиток, чтобы избежать ломки.

en: You're "hooked" on Buffout. You need to consume this drug to avoid withdrawal.
ru: Вы "подсели" на баффаут. Вам необходимо принимать этот препарат, чтобы избежать ломки.

en: You're "hooked" on Mentats. You need to consume this drug to avoid withdrawal.
ru: Вы "подсели" на ментат. Вам необходимо принимать этот препарат, чтобы избежать ломки.

en: You're "hooked" on Psycho. You need to consume this drug to avoid withdrawal.
ru: Вы "подсели" на психо. Вам необходимо принимать этот препарат, чтобы избежать ломки.

en: You're "hooked" on RadAway. You need to consume this drug to avoid withdrawal.
ru: Вы "подсели" на антирадин. Вам необходимо принимать этот препарат, чтобы избежать ломки.

en: Sniper Shot.
Precision Aim (+20% hit chance).
Increased Armor Penetration (+80% armor penetration ).
Knockback of enemy ( more chances than without the ability - 1 hex for 5 points of damage ).
ru: Отбрасывает врага (шансы больше, чем без способности - 1 гекс для 5 очков урона).

en: Power Armor (+3 Strength, +30 Radiation Resistance ).
ru: Силовая броня (+3 к Силе, +30 к сопротивляемости радиации).

en: Combat Armor (+20 Radiation Resistance ).
Scope ( changes the hit probability calculation formula ).
ru: Оптический прицел (меняет расчетную формулу вероятности попадания).

en: High-speed Reload ( only 1 AP is spent on reloading).
ru: Скоростная перезарядка (на перезарядку тратится всего 1 ОД).

en: Night Vision Scope ( removes darkness penalty ).
ru: Прицел ночного видения (удаляет штраф к темноте).

en: Hot Shot ( lowers the threshold for the victim's combustion animation ).
ru: Горячий парень (снижает порог для анимации возгорания жертвы).

en: Improved Power Armor I (+4 Strength, +60 Radiation Resistance ).

en: Welcome to the Rob Co Pipboy 2000.
So long.
Wake up.
Rules of Survival
Founder's Notes
Diary from Vault 27
Expedition Report
Mission to Quartz

Orders of Casa Grande
Field notes by G. Crook

Luther's Notes
-- EMPTY--
**END-PAR**
**END-DISK**
These records I leave for my descendants as a
warning. Keep them secret from the other inhabitants
and pass them from father to son, as my father did to
me.
Our people's history begins in Vault 27. This massive
underground bunker was built before the Great War,
and is located near Phoenix, Arizona.
**END-PAR**
To you, my descendants, such a place might seem
unwelcoming and strange. You are used to the sunlight
and the golden sands of Sonora; you cannot
understand the gloomy rooms of the Vault with its low
ceilings and cold steel walls. But those very walls and
technology saved our lives and our ancestors' lives,
when nuclear bombs fell on the earth.
**END-PAR**
For a long time, we didn't dare to go to the surface.
The world above was uninhabitable due to mutants,
ruins, and high radiation. But the longer the
scientists and citizens argued about it, the fewer
resources remained in the Vault for survival. Society
was fracturing, riots broke out one after another,
and some residents left for the wasteland on their
own. A decision had to be made quickly. The only thing
that could ensure our survival was the Garden of Eden
Creation Kit. A great pre-war technology capable of
breathing life into the desert. Scientists agreed that
using it near the Vault would be a reckless waste of
this valuable technology. The positive effect would be
nullified by the environment. And we couldn't explore
distant lands.
**END-PAR**
When the situation became desperate, I gathered the
best people I could trust even a little. We stole the
G.E.C.K. and left the Vault, leaving most of the
population to fend for themselves. The journey was
tough. Many died from radiation, mutants, and
occasional raiders. Some betrayed us and were
executed. At the end of the journey, only a few
families remained. When hope was lost, we stumbled
upon this unremarkable place. The G.E.C.K. detector
deemed it suitable for creating a garden city. But
even with this technology, it took years before we
managed to establish the Villa.
**END-PAR**
Now you know the price of our prosperity. And
although I do not regret what happened, doubts
remain deep in my soul. Did we do the right thing? How
many people did we betray? How many did we doom to
suffering after our departure? No one can answer
these questions now. So the only right decision is to
forget the past and live for the future.
**END-PAR**
Our future is our land and our children. Protect them.
Preserve our way. Avoid ancient technologies. Drive
away outsiders before they can cause harm. If one
generation breaks the covenant, the community will
fall.
**END-PAR**
Just as Vault 27 once fell.
**END-DISK**
- October 23, 2077:
Starting this diary on the advice of the
psychologist. My family and I were at home doing our
usual activities when suddenly the siren blared over
Mesa. Catherine thought it was a routine system
check. Still, I insisted we take shelter in the vault.
On the way, the radio reported the first explosions
on the West Coast. Soon after, we saw a flash over
Phoenix. The sound of the explosion reached us later.
**END-PAR**
Moving in was hell. There was a jam before the vault,
we had to abandon the car on the road. We were
assigned a room and given one Pip-Boy for the whole
family. They also put Mexicans in our room! Turns out,
there are way more people in the vault than there
should be. We were lucky - some are sleeping in the
corridors. What were the Vault-Tec clerks thinking
when they made the settlement lists?
**END-PAR**
- November 12, 2077:
My neighbors and I couldn't get along for a long time.
We divided the room with a screen into two parts.
Catherine demanded that I evict them. But what can I
do in such a situation? The children reconciled us. For
their sake, we agreed to behave decently. After all,
little Susie has the hardest time of all. And the
overseer can't cope with overpopulation. Information
about illegal settlers turned out to be false. It looks
like Vault-Tec is in for some serious lawsuits. But
what should we do now?
**END-PAR**
- February 7, 2078:
My Mexican neighbor was killed, suspicions fell on me, of
course. I spent a day in a punishment cell. The killer
turned out to be a former truck driver - typical
criminal, mentally ill. He finally went crazy and claimed
that the vault was overpopulated with illegal Mexicans.
But something else is more important. I used to want
the neighbors to disappear. And now I feel like I've lost
a family member. And by the way, only 15% of the
population is Mexican. Their eviction will not solve the
problem permanently.
**END-PAR**
- December 11, 2082:
Water and electricity supplies have been cut. The
education and entertainment sections are closed. Food
rations are given out on schedule, one per person.
More deaths, and there are fights in the corridors.
The medical office is overwhelmed. Constant stress.
**END-PAR**
- January 2, 2083:
Another murder, this time a white American. Zachary
Taylor, a former soldier and Anchorage veteran, took
charge of the investigation. He quickly found the
"culprit" and, along with his followers, carried out a
lynching. I had to go along with it to avoid suspicion,
but I stood in the column of dissenters. I need to be
more cautious and take a neutral, waiting position. I
initially sympathized with Taylor, but when he
suggested expelling all Mexicans outside, I got
seriously worried. I wouldn't want to see such a person
as overseer.
**END-PAR**
Hugo and his gang seized the water purification
section and started blackmailing the overseer.
Taylor's men took action. The two factions
slaughtered each other in the cramped spaces. It
ended with the lynching of all the defeated, as well as
their accomplices and the station workers. Well. We fled
to the vault to escape war. But war awaited us here.
Maybe it's in people's blood. Susie cries at night when
she dreams of our home. Can't wait to get to the
surface.
**END-PAR**
- December 16, 2084:
This is the end. The overseer cut all the supplies.
Taylor's men killed him in his sleep and forcefully took
his position. Now Zachary Taylor is our new overseer.
And I dread to think what rules this old soldier will
establish here. Twenty people disappeared from the
vault overnight. No one saw anything. No one knows
anything. And under no circumstances should you ask
about it.
**END-PAR**
- August 24, 2091:
Thanks to Taylor's dictatorship, order and discipline
have reigned in the vault all this time. It was hard, but
we managed. There are rumors of going to the surface.
This thought is incredibly welcome, especially for Susie.
But the overseer made it clear that it's too early. If
you think about it, much has changed: a new
generation has grown up, and we have grown old and
gotten used to these cold walls. Most are afraid to
leave. And where would we go? My house is probably
burned down or crumbled to dust. And what about
here? We lack food, water, air, and the blue sky
overhead. We need time to gather our thoughts.
**END-PAR**
- January 18, 2092:
There are more and more heated debates about
leaving. Reconnaissance results are disappointing.
Some believe that the G.E.C.K. will change the
situation, others think its effect will be muted by the
environment. Society is splitting into factions again,
just like it did before. But the overseer is not the
same - he's old and weak. The strength has faded from
his face. Or maybe it's the dim light illuminating his
tired gaze. Will we really grow old in this crypt? Some
have left the vault. Taylor told them not to return.
And Susie was with them. I am pathetic.
**END-PAR**
Felix Tejada did it. He fought his way to the G.E.C.K.
and led his followers into the wasteland. He had been
preparing for this plan for several years. I also
received an invitation from him, but I declined. After
all, Katherine wouldn't go, and she is the only thing I
have left. And I simply don't want to. The overseer has
sealed the vault door for good. Ironically, he used to
want to expel as many people as possible, but now he
won't let anyone out.
**END-PAR**
Now the vault is empty. And quiet.
**END-PAR**
Like a crypt.
**END-PAR**
That's fine. Let it stay that way.
**END-DISK**
Compiled by:
**END-PAR**
Abel Dragger, Enlightened by Nuclear Flame and
Loyal Servant of the Rising Phoenix (note: the only
one who can read and write among these dimwits)
**END-PAR**
- Report #02-04: We reached our destination, but as
the guide warned, the vault door was closed. The door
console does not respond to commands, it seems there
is no electricity in the vault. We'll have to dig. I'm
sending a list of necessary tools to headquarters.
Casualties: one slave twisted his ankle while carrying
equipment, had to shoot him. Plans until the convoy
arrives: fortify the camp, survey the area, start
digging.
**END-PAR**
- Report #02-09:
Received shipment requested in report 02-04. Just in
time: we are almost at the steel wall of the vault. The
guide suddenly left the camp. Before leaving, he
warned of the vault's curse, which caused unrest
among the slaves. Had to apply force to shut them up.
**END-PAR**
- Report #02-10:
The digging was completed despite the useless slaves.
Nearly all the explosives were used to breach the wall.
The condition of the vault is unsatisfactory, there is
no electricity, the elevator is blocked. Descending to
the lower levels is currently impossible. We are sending
a convoy with valuable finds: medical equipment
(Autodoc, tools), electrotechnical parts (spools of
cable, vacuum tubes, terminal parts), archival records
from the computers. This is much less than the
headquarters expected.
**END-PAR**
- Report #03-01:
We blew up the elevator and lowered a rope to the
bottom. The slaves heard weird sounds from the lower
floors and mistook them for ghost voices. This scared
them and caused them to flee. Casualties: one
mercenary killed and two wounded; three slaves
escaped, the rest were killed. For the next convoy, we
request new slaves. Exploration of the lower levels is
on hold. Setting up lighting equipment.
**END-PAR**
- Report #03-02:
Looks like that guide was right - the vault really is
cursed! Something on the lower level grabbed the
lighting technician and dragged him into the darkness.
Two mercenaries went after him and did not return.
Gunshots were heard. The expedition members are
terrified. We plan a massive sweep of the levels with
the remaining team.
**END-PAR**
**END-DISK**
Your mission is to carry the ideas of the Holy Fire to
the lands of barbarians and heretics. Be ready for
misunderstanding and persecution by stupid savages,
for detachment from earthly goods and self-sacrifice.
Do not hesitate. This is your holy burden.
**END-PAR**
Your mission has two goals.
**END-PAR**
The first is to create a colony on the ruins of
Quartzsite that is sympathetic to our faith. Such a
colony will become a regional center for the spread of
ideas of the Holy Fire, one of the pillars of our future.
But beware of heretical rangers, their base is 50 miles
north. For cover, pretend to be ordinary refugees
from Phoenix, as if looking for a new home.
**END-PAR**
The second is to collect the sacred nuclear resources
of this city and prepare them for dispatch to Phoenix.
According to our data, there is one of the Tombs of
Atom in Quartzsite - the Petro-Chico gas station.
Find it and open it with all due respect. If it is
impossible to send the resources keep them under the
cover of the colony until new orders are received from
the Council.
**END-PAR**
Maintain the strictest secrecy of the mission, in case
of danger, destroy this holodisk.
**END-PAR**
May the Holy Fire be with you.
**END-PAR**
Amen.
**END-PAR**
**END-DISK**
[heavy breathing] To those who find this recording...
I'm Sergeant McBain from Davis-Monthan AFB...
... Our security robots have rebelled and killed almost
all the team members. Damn ZAX must have done this! I
told the lieutenant you can't trust our lives to
soulless machines. And here is the result...
... I'm in an isolated room now. Robots can't get in here.
But it's a matter of time. I still can't leave the
training ground on my own. And there has been no help
for three days...
Radio communication is blocked, intercoms are not
working. And I don't know what's going on upstairs...
... All I can do is disable ZAX. I'm going to go
downstairs, find the console and set up an emergency
pulse explosion so this thing's electronic guts get
burned out!
God help me...
**END-PAR**
**END-DISK**
DIRECTIVES
for resolving the situation in Casa Grande
for the current and future mayor
**END-PAR**
The unstable social situation in Casa Grande harms the
development of the entire region. Without this "oasis"
any trade and industrial processes in Southern
Arizona will be hindered. You must resolve the conflict
as soon as possible, caused by the city's
overpopulation. Otherwise, the consequences will be
fatal. Therefore, do not hesitate to take drastic
measures.
**END-PAR**
Measures for Prevention and Resolution:
**END-PAR**
- Legalization of Power
**END-PAR**
You must present yourself as the true leader of the
city. For this, any means are suitable, including
threats, lies, and bribery. Declare yourself mayor,
fabricate a legend about your achievements and
deceive the city with rigged elections.
**END-PAR**
- Elimination of Dissidents and Conflict Citizens
**END-PAR**
You should only keep those inhabitants who support
or fear you. Come up with cunning methods - poisoning,
accidents, execution on false charges.
**END-PAR**
- Implementation of Population Supervision and Control
**END-PAR**
They must fear you. The best way for this is
intimidation and public executions. You must wield
power - weapons and loyal soldiers. Hire mercenaries,
you can always dispose of them later.
**END-PAR**
- Seizing Key Positions in the City
**END-PAR**
You must place a loyal dog in charge of the water
station who will guard the station from outsiders. In
case of resistance from the current owner - spread
slanderous rumors about him and create a false
pretext for an open attack, when the odds are in your
favor.
**END-PAR**
- Forming Trade Alliances
**END-PAR**
This struggle will eventually end. But once you emerge
victorious, remain vigilant. Without the support of the
Tinsmiths and the Church of the Holy Fire your water
empire won't last long.
**END-PAR**
Don't worry about caps. We share a common goal, and

en: we are ready to support your endeavors.
**END-PAR**
And remember - History is on your side.
**END-PAR**
**END-DISK**
Aaron, my Lord!
I hasten to inform you of our situation.
**END-PAR**
We've been stationed near San Brahmin three weeks
now. Any longer, and my soldiers will start marrying
these filthy and ugly savages.
**END-PAR**
We're running out of provisions, I asked the supply
center to send additional rations (full request
attached to the report).
**END-PAR**
During this time, I've tried numerous times to
establish contact with the local chiefs and persuade
them to ally. But the chiefs stand firm, like a stubborn
pack brahmin. Today we had another round of talks,
and I was only mocked.
**END-PAR**
We're just wasting time, my lord. These filthy savages
can't be assimilated or made an autonomous part of
the empire. They can only be subdued with a harsh whip
and steel shackles, like in the good old days.
**END-PAR**
I beg you, Aaron. Give me more soldiers and weapons,
and I'll capture the old pueblo in no time. I'll disarm
these savages so they cease to be a threat to
ordinary people and caravanners. I'll drive the
remnants of the dissenters into a reserve like a herd
of mindless cattle.
**END-PAR**
Just give the order!
**END-PAR**
Your faithful servant and kindred spirit,
Commander George Crook
**END-PAR**
**END-DISK**
Dear Mr. and Mrs. Buren,
**END-PAR**
Congratulations on being accepted into the vault
community!
**END-PAR**
Enclosed, you will find a complete set of rules and
procedures related to preparing for your move to the
"Vault-Tec" facility, but we want to highlight a few
key points:
**END-PAR**
- "Vault-Tec" provides residents with furnished
accommodations, clothing, and bedding. Your personal
belongings must be inspected and approved by an
authorized "Vault-Tec" technician. Only then can they be
delivered to your reserved vault quarters. In case of an
emergency move to the facility, you will not be able to
bring any personal items.
**END-PAR**
- All vault residents must participate in an orientation
seminar. If you haven't attended during your application
and review process, please contact your assigned Vault-
Tec representative.
**END-PAR**
- In the event of vault activation (both real and drill),
Vault-Tec will sound a siren, audible in the vicinity of
the vault. Residents will also receive a holographic
message at the phone number listed in their records.
Upon receiving such a signal, immediately proceed
to the vault and await entry authorization.
**END-PAR**
We eagerly await you becoming our dearest guests!
**END-PAR**
Sincerely,
Vault-Tec Public Relations Department
Phoenix, Arizona
**END-DISK**
That's it.
**END-PAR**
Only five people left on the platform.
**END-PAR**
It's become quiet and peaceful here. Not long ago, the
military stormed the platform. Chaos ensued! Workers
fought to keep their jobs, but the government
machine was stronger. It was clear from the start. I
don't understand what they expected in times like
these. A big scandal erupted on the mainland involving
federal television. But they have no chance. Only a
fool would go against a giant corporation.
**END-PAR**
Even I wasn't sure that automating the station would
succeed. Can such complex systems be trusted to a
program? What if the systems go rogue? How can a
handful of admin staff in the middle of the sea handle
such a giant in an emergency?
**END-PAR**
But it seems robots are even better than humans.
They don't need pay or complain about working
conditions. Local oil will power the station, making it
fully autonomous and likely to last a hundred years
until the robots wear out. Of course, the company
saved a lot by laying off workers. It's just a shame we
have to feed ourselves; even the cooks were sent
ashore.
**END-PAR**
Now for the main news - thanks to modernization in
production, my salary was doubled! There's a silver
lining to everything.
**END-DISK**
Vault 24, Overseer's Journal.
**END-PAR**
**END-PAR**
**END-PAR**
- February 2131:
**END-PAR**
So, the capabilities of our vault are almost exhausted.
In recent years, we have survived only thanks to old
technology and items that we managed to bring from
the ruins above. In these excursions we have lost
some of our brothers and sisters. We can no longer
stay here. Where should we go? Can we survive in the
wasteland without the vault's technology?
**END-PAR**
- December 2131:
**END-PAR**
A miracle happened! Today we met a few people among
the ruins. These people came from a city called Adytum
(apparently, it is located in the suburbs of Los
Angeles). They were looking for a place they called the
Glow. As we understood, they were referring to the
ruined West-Tek laboratory, but it seemed that they
themselves didn't understand what they were
searching for. The old technology has become some
sort of mystical artifacts for them, the meaning of
which has long been forgotten. We were much luckier,
because thanks to the vault, we preserved many pre-
war era knowledge. But given our dire situation, we
have to make contact even with the savages. A
thorough reconnaissance of this Adytum and other
settlements should be conducted. Volunteers are in
abundance.
**END-PAR**
**END-PAR**
Our scouts have returned. They brought two pieces of
news. The good news is that people live on the ruins of
Los Angeles and its surroundings! We could settle near
them and try to revive the world together. The bad
news is that the local population has greatly
degenerated, regressing three centuries back in
development. Perhaps we will even have to fight for
our place among the ruins. But we are far from being
warriors. We have the sick and infirm with us. But
enough of wars! The world has suffered enough in the
flames, we will not repeat the mistakes of our
ancestors. Our knowledge and faith are our strength.
We will restore factories, hospitals, libraries, and
chapels, to return lost civilization to the world and
heal the wounds of the soul.
**END-PAR**
- January 2136:
**END-PAR**
We are the last ones destined to leave the vault. And
most likely, we will not return here. Our brothers and
sisters have set up a library near Adytum and are now
teaching the locals the lost knowledge. We are
respected, and some even see us as missionaries. This
is our chance to create a new world, without wars and
destruction. Some try to take this hope away from us.
But we won't allow it. The library will be our fortress,
knowledge will be our weapon, and faith will be our
shining armor. God help us.
**END-DISK**
